paper.title: Not All Attention Heads Contribute to Critical Visual Token Selection: Head-Aware Pruning Matters More
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have exhibited impressive performance across diverse visual scenarios. However, this success comes at the cost of explosive growth in visual tokens, which imposes substantial memory and computational overhead during inference, ultimately increasing latency. To improve VLM inference efficiency, a typical class of visual token pruning methods estimates token importance by aggregating attention scores across all heads in the pruning layer of the Large Language Model (L

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 推理中视觉 token 数量过多导致的显存、计算和延迟开销，并指出现有按所有 attention heads 聚合注意力分数的 token pruning 方法会稀释真正有用的选择信号。
summary.importance: 贡献是训练免费的 VLM 推理压缩方法和一个有用现象：关键视觉 token 的识别能力集中在少数 attention heads 中。它不是基座预训练方法，但对视觉 token 压缩、长视觉上下文推理和 VLM serving 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProViP，一种 head-aware progressive visual token pruning 框架。先根据输入 token embedding 相似度移除冗余视觉 token，再在 LLM backbone 的 pruning layer 中选择更擅长定位关键视觉 token 的少数 heads，用这些 heads 的注意力信号做逐步剪枝，而不是对全部 heads 做无差别聚合；方法强调 training-free。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称、压缩率或提升幅度，只说明与典型全 head 聚合 pruning 相比，使用关键 heads 聚合可以提升任务表现，并降低 VLM 推理的显存和计算开销。需要正文确认不同 VLM、任务和 pruning ratio 下的稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the memory, compute, and latency cost of excessive visual tokens in VLM inference, arguing that common pruning methods dilute useful token-selection signals by aggregating attention scores across all heads.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a training-free VLM inference compression method and a useful empirical observation: only a small subset of attention heads is good at identifying critical visual tokens. It is not a foundation pretraining method, but it is relevant to visual-token compression, long visual-context inference, and VLM serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProViP is a head-aware progressive visual token pruning framework. It first removes redundant visual tokens using input-token embedding similarity, then selects heads in the LLM pruning layer that are better at locating critical visual tokens and uses their attention signals for progressive pruning instead of aggregating all heads uniformly.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, dataset names, pruning ratios, or exact gains. It states that aggregating over selected heads improves task performance over typical all-head aggregation while reducing memory and compute overhead during VLM inference. The main paper is needed to check robustness across VLMs, tasks, and pruning ratios.

recommendation.zh: 只看 head 选择实验和不同 pruning ratio 曲线；若现象稳，视觉 token 压缩不该再默认全 head 平均。
recommendation.en: Read only the head-selection ablation and pruning-ratio curves; if stable, visual-token pruning should stop defaulting to all-head averaging.

paper.title: Targeting the Attention Heads Behind Object Hallucination in LLaVA
paper.abstract: Vision-language models such as LLaVA-1.5-7B often hallucinate objects absent from the image when generating captions. We ask whether an interpretability diagnosis of this failure can guide a targeted fix, and we measure what that fix actually changes. We rank attention heads by how much their image attention drops around hallucinated object words, then screen the shortlist by ablating candidate heads and measuring the change in hallucination-token log probability, yielding a 32-head set. We rest

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LLaVA-1.5-7B 在开放式图像描述中产生对象幻觉的问题，并进一步问一个更具体的问题：能否把幻觉行为定位到少数注意力头，再只对这些头做干预，而不是对整个模型做粗粒度微调或解码修正。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对 VLM 机制分析和可控干预有参考意义。它的价值在于把“注意力头与幻觉相关”推进到“基于注意力头选择的局部适配是否改变行为”。这类诊断到干预的闭环，对理解多模态基座模型中视觉 grounding 信号如何在 LM 层传播有帮助。不过结果也提示，降低幻觉并不等于更好地使用图像信息，方法会让模型更保守、输出更短、对象召回下降。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三步。第一步，在 200 张 COCO val2014 图像上生成 caption，并用 COCO 标注和 CHAIR 规则把对象词标为 grounded 或 hallucinated。对 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的 32 层、每层 32 个注意力头逐一统计对象词附近对图像 token 的注意力，优先找出在幻觉对象词附近图像注意力下降明显的头。第二步，对候选头做单头 ablation，观察 hallucination-token log probability 的变化，最后选出 32 个影响最大的头，分布在 19 个 transformer layer。第三步，只在这些头上做两类干预：一类是 head-sliced LoRA，只对相关层的 Q/K/V 投影中对应 head 维度开放更新，并用梯度 mask 限制学习范围；另一类是推理时 grounding controller，当这些头对图像 token 的注意力弱时，对生成分布施加惩罚。LoRA 训练使用 DPO 风格目标，chosen response 是 COCO ground-truth caption，rejected response 是模型自己的幻觉 caption，LoRA rank 为 8，alpha 为 16，dropout 为 0.05，训练 3 个 epoch。和普通 LoRA 相比，关键差异是参数更新被限制到诊断出的 head slice；和纯解码方法相比，它同时改变局部参数和推理时 token 分布。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在 400 张 held-out COCO 图像上进行，固定 prompt 为“Describe this image in detail.”。完整的 LoRA + Grounding 方法把 CHAIRs 从 0.370 降到 0.230，把 CHAIRi 从 0.156 降到 0.096，paired sign-flip test 显示 p < 0.001。论文还做了重要控制实验：在另一个 200 图像控制集上，层位置匹配的随机 head LoRA 在相同训练 recipe 下 CHAIRs 为 0.400，基本没有优于匹配 baseline；而 selected-head adapter 在同一批图像上把 CHAIRs 降到 0.100。这说明收益不只是 LoRA 容量带来的。长度鲁棒性实验显示，在相同 token budget 下仍能降低 CHAIRs，相对收益从 64 token 时的 23% 增至 128 token 时的 58%。但论文也明确指出，方法会生成更短、更保守的 caption，并降低对象 recall，因此 CHAIR 改善同时包含真实幻觉下降和少说对象带来的收益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 到 30 分钟。重点看方法部分的 head selection 和 ablation-screening 设计，以及 selected-head LoRA 与随机 head LoRA 的控制实验。实验部分不要只看 CHAIRs/CHAIRi，还要同时看 caption length、object recall、token budget sensitivity 和 SPIN/VCD 对比。真正值得带走的是诊断信号如何被转成局部干预，而不是把这篇论文当成通用 VLM 幻觉解决方案。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies object hallucination in LLaVA-1.5-7B captioning and asks whether the failure can be localized to a small set of attention heads, then mitigated by interventions restricted to those heads.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect but useful for VLM mechanistic analysis. The main contribution is a diagnosis-to-intervention loop: identify heads associated with weak image grounding around hallucinated object words, then adapt and control only those heads. The result is informative because it shows both a measurable hallucination reduction and an important tradeoff: the model becomes more conservative, produces shorter captions, and loses object recall.
summary_en.technical_approach: The pipeline has three stages. First, captions are generated on 200 COCO val2014 images, and object mentions are labeled as grounded or hallucinated using a COCO-based CHAIR scorer. For each object token, the method records image-token attention for all 1,024 attention heads in LLaVA-1.5-7B and ranks heads by the drop in image attention around hallucinated object words relative to grounded ones. Second, the strongest candidates are screened by single-head ablation, measuring the change in hallucination-token log probability. This yields a fixed set of 32 heads spanning 19 transformer layers. Third, two interventions are applied only to this set: a head-sliced LoRA adapter on the corresponding Q/K/V head dimensions, enforced with gradient masking, and an inference-time grounding controller that penalizes generation when the selected heads attend weakly to image tokens. The LoRA stage uses a DPO-style objective where COCO ground-truth captions are chosen responses and the model’s hallucinated captions are rejected responses. The reported LoRA configuration is rank 8, alpha 16, dropout 0.05, trained for three epochs.
summary_en.experiments: On 400 held-out COCO images with the fixed prompt “Describe this image in detail,” the full LoRA + Grounding method reduces CHAIRs from 0.370 to 0.230 and CHAIRi from 0.156 to 0.096, with paired sign-flip tests giving p < 0.001. A useful control uses a separate 200-image split: a layer-matched random-head LoRA trained with the same recipe gives CHAIRs of 0.400, while the selected-head adapter reduces CHAIRs to 0.100 on the same images. This supports the claim that head selection matters beyond LoRA capacity. Token-budget checks show that the method still reduces CHAIRs under equal decoding budgets, with relative gains increasing from 23% at 64 tokens to 58% at 128 tokens. The caveat is central: the intervention shortens captions and lowers object recall, so the CHAIR gains combine improved grounding with a shift toward saying less.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the head-ranking and ablation-screening procedure, then inspect the selected-head versus random-head LoRA control. In the results, read CHAIRs and CHAIRi together with caption length, object recall, token-budget sensitivity, and the SPIN/VCD comparisons. The useful idea is the localized intervention pipeline, not the headline hallucination metric alone.

recommendation.zh: 将 VLM 幻觉定位到具体的 attention head 并通过 head-sliced LoRA 修复，机制分析做得很干净，对 VLM 内部机制研究和轻量级对齐有启发，值得看 §3 的定位方法。
recommendation.en: Localizes VLM hallucinations to specific attention heads and fixes them via head-sliced LoRA; clean mechanistic analysis, inspiring for VLM internal mechanism research and lightweight alignment; worth reading §3 for the localization method.

paper.title: HAP: Head-Adaptive Visual Token Pruning via Cross-Modal Alignment
paper.abstract: Recent Vision-Language Models encode high-resolution images into long visual token sequences, incurring prohibitive prefill costs. To compress them, existing methods score each visual token by averaging text-to-visual attention uniformly across all heads, which assumes every head matches the query. However, our empirical analysis shows that misaligned heads dominate the average, amplifying background tokens and drowning out fine-grained cues.   To address this, we propose PAQ (Prompt-Grounded At

summary.core_problem: 解决 VLM 高分辨率图像带来的长视觉 token 序列 prefill 成本过高问题，重点是更稳健地做视觉 token pruning。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率工作。对基座研究员的价值不在方法本身，而在一个具体观察：跨模态注意力头并不都对 prompt 对齐，简单平均会把错头的噪声放大。这个观察对后续视觉 token 压缩和 head-level routing 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 HAP，核心指标是 PAQ（Prompt-Grounded Attention Quality），用于衡量每个注意力头把文本 prompt 对齐到图像区域的质量。方法分三步：先按 FLOPs 预算给不同层组分配视觉 token 预算；再在组内用 PAQ 加权 softmax 聚合各头注意力；最后按聚合矩阵幅值给 token 打分并裁剪。关键改动是从“所有头等权平均”改为“按 head 对齐质量加权”。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体模型、分辨率、压缩率和精度损失，只能确认其目标是降低 VLM prefill 成本，并与基于平均 text-to-visual attention 的 pruning 方法比较。若实验完整，最值得看的应是 head misalignment 分析和不同预算下的精度-延迟曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the high prefill cost of long visual token sequences in VLMs, focusing on more reliable visual token pruning.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper. Its main value for foundation-model researchers is not the pruning recipe itself, but the observation that cross-modal attention heads are not equally aligned with the prompt, so naive averaging amplifies noisy heads. That is mildly useful for future visual compression and head-level routing work.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes HAP with a key metric called PAQ (Prompt-Grounded Attention Quality), which measures how well each attention head aligns the text prompt to image regions. The method first allocates token budgets across layer groups under a FLOPs target, then aggregates per-head attention maps using PAQ-weighted softmax, and finally scores and prunes visual tokens based on the resulting group-level matrix. The core change is replacing uniform head averaging with alignment-aware weighting.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model names, resolutions, compression ratios, or accuracy drops. It is clear, however, that the paper compares against prior pruning methods based on averaged text-to-visual attention and targets lower VLM prefill cost. If the paper is solid, the most useful parts are the head-misalignment analysis and the accuracy-latency tradeoff under different budgets.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“错头平均会害死 token pruning”这个观察值得记一下；只看 head analysis 和 budget allocation，方法细节可略。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the 'misaligned heads break token pruning' observation is worth keeping; read the head analysis and budget allocation, skip the rest.

paper.title: Grounding Isn't Knowing: Do VLMs Need Object Localization for Spatial Reasoning?
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer spatial questions, yet the mechanisms connecting object grounding to spatial reasoning remain poorly understood. It is underexplored whether spatial reasoning internally requires precise objects localization, or can bypass explicit localization through global layout cues. summary.core_problem: VLM 做空间推理时，是否真的依赖精确目标定位，还是可以绕过显式 localization 直接用全局布局线索。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作。价值不在提出新模型，而在把“grounding 与 reasoning 的接口”拆开看，对多模态预训练里表示形成和中间监督设计有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 选取 LLaVA-1.5 和 Qwen2.5-VL 两类 VLM，用 token ablation、layer-wise probing、attention knockout、causal mediation analysis 等工具分析空间关系预测的内部过程，追踪定位信息、关系决策和关键注意力头的因果作用。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示两类模型都呈现 staged grounding-to-reasoning：先形成粗粒度 target-reference anchor，再做关系判断；精确 bounding box 边界并非必要。位置编码信息先于关系决策变得可解码，少量注意力头承担 localization 与 reasoning 的因果中介。未见新的大规模训练实验。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether VLM spatial reasoning truly requires precise object localization, or whether models can bypass explicit localization using global layout cues.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper. Its value is not a new model, but a cleaner decomposition of the grounding–reasoning interface, which is mildly useful for thinking about representation formation and intermediate supervision in multimodal pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL, it applies token ablation, layer-wise probing, attention knockout, and causal mediation analysis to trace how positional information, relation decisions, and a small set of attention heads contribute to spatial reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a staged grounding-to-reasoning process in both model families: coarse target-reference anchoring emerges first, then relation prediction; precise bounding-box boundaries are not necessary. Positional information becomes decodable before relation decisions, and a few heads mediate both localization and reasoning. No new large-scale training study is involved.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 主线，但它把“定位监督是否必要”这个 prior 拆得比较干净；只看因果分析和关键头定位那几节就够。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it cleanly probes whether explicit localization supervision is actually needed; read only the causal analysis and key-head sections.

paper.title: Shared Circuits for Shared Grammar: Tracing Subject-Verb Agreement Across Languages
paper.abstract: Multilingual large language models often generalize across languages, and prior work suggests that their internal mechanisms can overlap cross-lingually. It remains unclear, however, when such sharing emerges and whether it varies with the overt realization of the same grammatical operation. We investigate this question for present-tense subject-verb agreement, a morphosyntactic process that varies substantially across languages and is only weakly expressed in English. Using activation patching

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的是多语言模型内部机制共享的边界：同一种语法操作在不同语言里是否由同一组电路实现，以及这种共享是否取决于该语法现象在表层上是否被显式表达。作者选了 present-tense subject-verb agreement 作为切口，因为它在语言类型学上差异很大：很多语言有明显的人称/数形态变化，英语只保留一部分，中文几乎没有。核心问题不是模型会不会做主谓一致，而是当它做这件事时，跨语言是否调用了共享 attention heads，还是各语言各自形成了独立解法。
summary.importance: 这不是直接服务于训练 recipe 的论文，但对 multilingual pretraining 很有信息量。它给出的启发是：跨语言参数共享不是均匀发生的，是否共享取决于底层语法结构是否真的对齐、以及这种结构在训练语料里是否有足够稳定的表层信号。对预训练研究者，这会影响三类判断：一是多语数据混合时哪些能力更可能正迁移；二是英语中心的机制解释能否迁移到其他语言；三是 tokenizer、语料覆盖和语言配比会怎样影响共享电路的形成。贡献量级属于机制分析里的扎实实证，不是训练方法创新，但它把“共享表示”这个常见口号落到了可因果检验的 head-level 证据上。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者在 29 种语言、五个开源模型家族、六个 checkpoint 上做 activation patching 和 attention analysis。实验设计比较克制，重点是控制变量。数据来自 UniMorph 等形态资源，先抽取动词原形及其现在时屈折形式，再用统一模板构造 zero-shot prompt，例如“Conjugation of the verb X in present tense: pronoun conjugation”，并针对各语言做适配。这样做牺牲了自然语境，但换来了 clean/corrupted prompt 的位置对齐，便于做 patching。作者区分了两种恢复指标：一种是 broader target-form recovery，即 patch 某个 head 后，模型是否更能恢复上下文正确的目标词；另一种是更严格的 minimal-pair inflection recovery，即只看它是否恢复了屈折对比本身。然后在各语言中识别对 agreement 有因果作用的 attention heads，再比较这些 head 集合在不同语言间的相似度。论文的关键判断不只是“有没有 overlap”，而是 overlap 是否随着 overt inflection 的强弱系统变化。结果显示，在显式标记人称/数的一组语言里，共享电路更明显；英语是桥接案例，它在 third-person singular 这类仍有屈折的情形上更接近强屈折语言，而在无屈折情形上相似度较低。作者还检查了这些重叠 heads 的 attention pattern，发现它们不仅位置重合，功能角色也相近，更像共享信息路由，而不只是偶然共址。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 29 种语言、五个模型家族、六个 checkpoint；初始词汇库存跨 34 种语言，单语言动词条目数从 56 到 23,782 不等，平均约 1,750。作者选了四类人称/数对比：1sg↔2sg、1sg↔3sg、1pl↔3pl、3sg↔3pl，其中英语只有两类存在屈折变化。主要结果有三点。第一，显式主谓一致语言之间的 agreement circuitry 有显著部分共享，尤其在 inflection-specific 的 minimal-pair 指标下更明显。第二，缺少人称屈折的语言与这组共享电路的相似度明显更低，说明共享不是“多语言模型天然统一”，而是跟共享语法结构和表层实现强相关。第三，instruction tuning、模型家族和规模会影响绝对模式，但不改变主结论。给出的全文片段没有完整数值表，因此不宜编造具体相似度百分比或 head 数量；真正精读时应回原文看各模型 family 的 similarity matrix、English bridge case 的分项结果，以及 attention pattern 可视化。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction，抓住作者真正问的问题：不是语言间能否迁移，而是共享电路何时出现。然后看 Experimental Setup，理解为什么他们宁可用模板化 prompt，也要保证 activation patching 的可比性。接着直接看主结果图：1）不同语言间 head-level similarity matrix；2）broad recovery 与 minimal-pair recovery 的差异；3）English 在不同对比类型上的桥接表现。若只花 20–30 分钟，重点读结果和讨论即可。若你关心 multilingual pretraining，值得深挖两点：一是 overt morphology 是否可以作为预测跨语迁移强弱的先验；二是这种 head-level overlap 会不会随着数据配比、tokenizer 切分方式、或 instruction tuning 程度而改变。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks when multilingual models reuse the same internal circuitry across languages, and when they do not. The test case is present-tense subject-verb agreement, which is ideal because the same grammatical operation is realized very differently across languages: many languages mark person and number overtly, English marks only part of it, and Chinese largely does not. The central question is not whether models can produce the right verb form, but whether the causal mechanism behind that behavior is shared across languages or implemented by language-specific circuits.
summary_en.importance: This is not a training-method paper, but it is highly relevant to multilingual pretraining. The main lesson is that parameter sharing does not imply uniform mechanistic sharing. Cross-lingual overlap depends on whether the underlying grammatical structure is genuinely aligned and whether it is stably expressed in the training signal. That matters for at least three reasons: it affects which capabilities are likely to transfer under multilingual data mixing; it limits how far English-centric interpretability results can generalize; and it suggests that tokenizer design, corpus composition, and language balance may shape whether shared circuits emerge at all. The contribution is a careful mechanistic study rather than a new model, but it grounds the vague idea of “shared representations” in causal head-level evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method combines activation patching and attention analysis across 29 languages, five open-source model families, and six checkpoints. The experimental design is deliberately controlled. The authors build verb inventories from morphological resources such as UniMorph, then create zero-shot prompts with a common template like “Conjugation of the verb X in present tense: pronoun conjugation,” adapted to each language. This is less natural than free-form text, but it preserves token-position alignment between clean and corrupted prompts, which is important for causal patching. They distinguish two recovery metrics: a broader target-form recovery metric, which asks whether patching a head helps restore the context-appropriate target token, and a stricter minimal-pair inflection recovery metric, which isolates restoration of the inflectional contrast itself. For each language, they identify the attention heads causally implicated in agreement, then compare these head-level signatures across languages. The key claim is not just that overlap exists, but that overlap varies systematically with overt inflection. Languages with clear person/number marking show stronger circuit similarity. English behaves as a bridge case: its third-person singular cases align more with strongly inflecting languages, while its non-inflecting cases do not. The paper also examines attention patterns of overlapping heads and finds that they play similar routing roles, not merely similar locations.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers 29 languages, five model families, and six checkpoints. The initial lexical inventory spans 34 languages, with the number of verb lemmas per language ranging from 56 to 23,782 and averaging about 1,750. The evaluation focuses on four person/number contrasts: 1sg↔2sg, 1sg↔3sg, 1pl↔3pl, and 3sg↔3pl; English has overt inflection in only two of these. The main findings are threefold. First, languages with overt subject-verb agreement show substantial overlap in the heads implicated in agreement, especially under the stricter minimal-pair inflection metric. Second, languages with weak or absent person-based inflection are much less similar to that shared signature, which argues against a simple “all multilingual processing is shared” story. Third, model family, size, and instruction tuning affect the absolute pattern but do not overturn the main trend. The provided text does not include the full numerical tables, so exact similarity values or head counts should be taken from the original figures rather than inferred here. The most important empirical artifacts to inspect are the language-by-language similarity matrices, the comparison between broad recovery and inflection-specific recovery, and the English bridge-case breakdown.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim starts with the introduction, because the paper is careful about the question it is asking: not whether transfer exists, but when shared circuitry emerges. Then read the experimental setup to understand why the authors prefer templated prompts over natural text; the reason is causal comparability for activation patching. After that, go straight to the main result figures: the head-level similarity matrices across languages, the contrast between broad recovery and minimal-pair recovery, and the English case split by inflecting versus non-inflecting contrasts. A 20 to 30 minute read is enough to get the main point. If your interest is multilingual pretraining, the deeper questions are whether overt morphology can serve as a prior for predicting transfer, and how the observed overlap might change with tokenizer granularity, language mixture, or instruction tuning.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不直接改 pretrain recipe，但会改变你对 multilingual sharing 的 prior：共享的不只是语义空间，某些形态操作真能落到可复用电路；读方法和主结果图就够。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your training recipe tomorrow, but it does update the prior that multilingual sharing can live in reusable circuits, not just embeddings; read the method and main comparison figures.

paper.title: Readable, Faithful, Used: Three Dissociable Properties of Demographic Identity in a Language Model
paper.abstract: Large language models are widely used to simulate survey respondents, yet their answers are homogeneous and unfaithful to real inter-group differences. We ask where demographic group identity lives inside an LLM, how faithfully its geometry mirrors real inter-group opinion structure, and whether it uses what it encodes. Using representational similarity analysis against Pew ground truth over 169 demographic cells, we score 1,089 read-out locations in Mistral-7B and intervene causally across six

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作在问：LLM 内部是否真的编码了人口统计身份相关的群体差异，这些表示是否接近真实世界的群体意见结构，以及模型在生成回答时是否实际使用了这些表示。
summary.importance: 重要性在于它把“模型会不会模拟群体差异”拆成了三个可分离属性：可读出、忠实、被使用。这不是常见的 fairness 打分，而是更接近表示机制分析。对做预训练的人，价值在于它提醒我们：某类社会属性可能并不主要存放在最后层 residual stream，而是分散在特定 attention head 中；同时“编码了”不等于“会在行为里用到”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者用 representational similarity analysis，把 Mistral-7B 不同层、不同 head 的读出与 Pew 调查中 169 个 demographic cells 的真实群体意见结构做对齐，系统扫描 1,089 个 read-out 位置。随后对六类属性做因果干预，区分三件事：哪里最容易读出身份信息、哪些位置的几何结构最忠实、模型回答时是否依赖这些位置。论文还控制了 lexical similarity，避免把表面词汇线索误当成身份表示。
summary.experiments: 实验主体是 Mistral-7B，并报告在六类人口属性上的结果。核心发现包括：标准的 last-token residual read-out 明显低估了模型内部可读出的身份结构；attention-head read-out 在六类中的五类上更强，selection-corrected fidelity 最高到 rho=0.63，接近作者估计的测量可靠性上限约 70%；存在一个固定 head（L11 H16）在六类属性上都显著，而 race 相关属性整体较弱且对 prompt 更脆弱。摘要还提到类似现象在另一个模型中的对应 head 上复现，但给出的截断信息不足，无法完整确认第二个模型与全部数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者。未见可确认的知名实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether demographic identity is actually encoded inside an LLM, whether that geometry matches real-world inter-group opinion structure, and whether the model uses those representations when generating answers.
summary_en.importance: Its value is that it separates three properties that are often conflated: readability, faithfulness, and usage. This is closer to representation-level mechanism analysis than standard fairness evaluation. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that socially relevant attributes may live more strongly in specific attention heads than in the usual last-token residual readout, and encoded information is not the same as behaviorally used information.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses representational similarity analysis to align internal readouts from Mistral-7B with Pew ground-truth opinion structure over 169 demographic cells. It scans 1,089 candidate readout locations across layers and heads, then performs causal interventions across six attribute types. The setup explicitly distinguishes where identity can be read out, where it is faithful to real group structure, and whether generation depends on those locations. A lexical-similarity control is included to avoid mistaking surface wording cues for demographic representation.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments are on Mistral-7B across six demographic attribute types. Key findings include: the standard last-token residual readout understates what the model contains; attention-head readouts outperform it on five of six types; selection-corrected fidelity reaches rho=0.63, around 70% of the estimated measurement-reliability ceiling; and one fixed head (L11 H16) is significant across all six types. Race-related attributes remain weak and prompt-fragile. The abstract also claims replication in an analogous head of another model, but the provided abstract is truncated and does not fully specify the second model or all numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is listed as an independent researcher. No clearly verifiable major lab affiliation is available.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练主线，但它把“表示存在”和“行为使用”拆开了；只看读出位置比较和因果干预部分，能直接启发你做 layer/head-level probing 设计。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it cleanly separates stored representation from behavioral use; read the readout-location comparison and intervention sections for actionable probing ideas.

paper.title: Attention-Path Fragility as an Uncertainty Signal in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: We propose that a model's uncertainty about a token is reflected not only in the breadth of its output distribution but also in whether a confident prediction is \emph{fragile} under perturbation of its attention pathways. We instantiate this as ASMI (Attention-Subnetwork Mutual Information), a training-free estimator that masks attention heads and measures the BALD mutual information among the resulting subnetworks, with a semantic-agreement kernel to discount surface-form disagreement. The sig

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作想解决的是：LLM 的不确定性是否不仅体现在输出分布熵上，还体现在“高置信预测对注意力路径扰动是否脆弱”这一内部结构信号上。
summary.importance: 它的重要性在于给出一种训练外、结构感知的不确定性估计方法，试图补足 token probability/entropy 对 confident-but-wrong 样本识别不足的问题。贡献类型是机制分析加 inference-time uncertainty estimation，不直接服务 pretrain，但对理解内部路由与可靠性有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ASMI（Attention-Subnetwork Mutual Information）：通过遮蔽不同 attention heads，构造多个 attention 子网络，然后计算这些子网络预测之间的 BALD mutual information，作为 attention-path fragility 信号。为避免只因表面措辞不同而高估分歧，还加入 semantic-agreement kernel。方法是 training-free 的，重点检测“模型看起来很自信，但其内部注意力路径并不稳”的 token。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 grounded QA 上进行。摘要声称在 out-of-fold 测试中，ASMI 在单次置信度和熵之外提供额外的 error-predictive information，尤其集中在 confident-but-fragile 区域；若用它过滤预测，保留样本中的错误率大约减半。作者还指出该信号有 regime dependence：当答案主要经由给定上下文路由时更强，而对参数记忆型回答天然受限。没有看到大规模预训练或跨模型训练动态分析，因此更适合作为可靠性工具而非基座结论。
summary.authors_note: POSCO Holdings Future Technology Research Institute。不是一线基座实验室，工作更偏可靠性分析与推理时不确定性估计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM uncertainty is reflected not only in output entropy, but also in whether a confident prediction is fragile to perturbations of its attention pathways.
summary_en.importance: Its value is in proposing a training-free, structure-aware uncertainty signal that may catch confident-but-wrong cases missed by token probabilities or entropy. The contribution is mechanism-flavored reliability analysis plus inference-time uncertainty estimation, not a direct pretraining result.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce ASMI (Attention-Subnetwork Mutual Information): they mask attention heads to create multiple attention subnetworks, then compute BALD-style mutual information among their predictions as a measure of attention-path fragility. A semantic-agreement kernel is added so that superficial wording differences do not inflate disagreement. The method is training-free and targets cases where the model appears confident but its internal routing is unstable.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are mainly on grounded QA. The abstract claims that, in out-of-fold tests, ASMI adds error-predictive information beyond single-pass confidence and entropy, especially in the confident-but-fragile regime; acting on this signal roughly halves the retained error of a confidence filter. The authors also note a regime dependence: the signal is strong when answers are routed through provided context and bounded when answers are recalled from parametric memory. There is no large-scale pretraining or training-dynamics angle, so this is better read as a reliability tool than a foundation-model result.
summary_en.authors_note: POSCO Holdings Future Technology Research Institute. This is not a frontier foundation-model lab; the work is more about reliability analysis and inference-time uncertainty estimation.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 核心文献，但“高置信且脆弱”这个切分值得记住；只看方法定义和 grounded QA 结果，别把它误读成通用 uncertainty 解法。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining reading, but the ‘confident yet fragile’ split is worth keeping; read the method definition and grounded-QA results, and don’t overgeneralize it as a universal uncertainty estimator.

paper.abstract: Despite remarkable progress in vision-language generation, Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remain prone to hallucinations, producing content that is inconsistent with or unsupported by the input image. Existing works largely design detection or mitigation methods around one specific hallucination pattern, such as visual-textual imbalance, but real VLM hallucinations arise from a mixture of multiple patterns, so signals bound to a single pattern struggle to remain stable across models and tasks. Un

summary.core_problem: VLM幻觉由多种模式混合引起，绑定单一模式（如视觉-文本失衡）的检测信号跨模型跨任务不稳定。
summary.importance: 原理分析类工作，从注意力头层面统一刻画幻觉信号，发现幻觉表现为各头偏离其忠实上下文行为的局部偏差（Role-Break），且该信号在保留头身份时线性可读。
summary.technical_approach: 在统一的头级别视角下分析幻觉诱导的注意力变化，发现偏差跨注意力头、上下文来源和偏差方向系统组织；在此基础上训练轻量线性检测器。
summary.experiments: 在多个VLM和任务上验证Role-Break检测器的跨模型跨任务稳定性（摘要截断，无具体模型名和数字）。
summary.authors_note: 作者含Nan Duan（段楠），MSRA Principal Researcher，在VLM/NLP/代码生成方向有大量代表性工作；论文标注机构为北京大学，可能为合作。

summary_en.core_problem: VLM hallucinations arise from a mixture of patterns, so detection signals bound to a single pattern (e.g., visual-textual imbalance) are unstable across models and tasks.
summary_en.importance: A mechanistic analysis work that characterizes hallucination signals at the attention-head level, finding that hallucinations manifest as localized deviations from each head's faithful contextual behavior (Role-Break), and that the resulting signal is linearly readable when head identity is preserved.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes hallucination-induced attention changes under a unified head-level view; finds deviations systematically organized across attention heads, contextual sources, and deviation directions; builds a lightweight linear detector on top of Role-Break features.
summary_en.experiments: Validates the Role-Break detector's cross-model and cross-task stability on multiple VLMs and tasks (abstract truncated, no specific model names or numbers).
summary_en.authors_note: Author list includes Nan Duan, Principal Researcher at MSRA with extensive work on VLMs, NLP, and code generation. The listed institution is Peking University, possibly indicating a collaboration.

recommendation.zh: 头级别Role-Break现象对LLM幻觉可解释性有弱迁移价值，但实验仅在VLM上且摘要无数字，作为literature备查即可。
recommendation.en: The head-level Role-Break phenomenon has weak transfer value to LLM hallucination interpretability, but experiments are VLM-only with no numbers in the abstract. Keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Temporal Context Reinstatement Drives Episodic-Like Order Memory in Long-Context Language Models
paper.abstract: Human episodic memory supports the retrieval of experiences that unfold over extended timescales, yet the computational mechanisms underlying this ability remain debated due to the limited mechanistic accessibility in long-term memory experiments in humans. Long-context LLMs may offer promising ways to reveal plausible computational mechanisms that drive this type of retrieval. Here, we investigate whether and how LLMs capture the core behavioral signatures of episodic memory via a temporal orde

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究长上下文语言模型是否能表现出类似人类情景记忆的时间顺序记忆，并进一步追问模型内部靠什么机制完成这种判断：是显式的时间位置表征，还是仅靠语义、因果和叙事线索推断先后顺序。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在长上下文机制分析，而不是训练 recipe。论文把“长上下文是否真的在用时间结构”这个问题做成了可测、可干预的任务。结果指向一个重要现象：模型在长文本检索时不只是匹配语义片段，还会在检索阶段重建低维时间上下文。这对长上下文预训练、位置编码设计、KV-cache 记忆解释、长程评测设计都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文设计了 Sequence Order Recall Task，给定一部长篇文本中的两个不重叠 50 词片段，要求判断哪个片段在原文中更早出现。作者用完整小说构造人类行为数据，并让长上下文 LLM 在相同任务上评测。关键分析不是停留在行为相似性，而是进入模型内部：先定位隐藏状态中是否存在可线性读出的时间顺序信息，再分析 retrieval 阶段哪些 attention head 会从 KV-cache 中重新激活这种时间码。论文报告一个专门的 attention head 会重建低维 temporal code，并通过因果干预验证它对顺序判断有实际作用。这与“模型只是利用故事语义链推断顺序”的解释不同。
summary.experiments: 主要结果包括三点。第一，模型和人类都表现出 distance effect：两个片段在原文中距离越远，顺序判断越容易。第二，模型内部存在低维时间表征，可用于解释顺序判断表现。第三，某个特化 attention head 在 retrieval 阶段从 KV-cache 中恢复时间信息；对该 head 或相关表征做干预会影响 temporal order judgment。文中还发布 ICMemory-Kit，用于长上下文记忆与机制解释实验。给定材料中没有提供具体模型参数量、上下文长度、样本规模和干预幅度数字，阅读时需要到实验章节核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看任务构造和人类数据部分，确认 SORT 是否排除了明显的语义捷径。然后看 temporal code 的定位方法，以及 attention head 的因果验证实验。最值得细读的是模型如何区分“时间上下文恢复”和“语义链推断”，因为这决定了结论对长上下文预训练是否有外推意义。若只关心工程启发，可重点看 attention/KV-cache 分析和 ICMemory-Kit 的接口设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-context language models exhibit human-like temporal order memory over extended naturalistic inputs, and what internal mechanism supports this behavior: an explicit temporal position code or inference from semantic and narrative structure.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is mechanistic insight into long-context memory. The work turns a vague question—whether a model actually uses temporal structure—into a controlled task with behavioral comparison and causal probing. The key implication is that long-context retrieval may rely on reinstating a low-dimensional temporal context, not only on matching semantic content. This matters for long-context pretraining, positional representation design, KV-cache analysis, and evaluation of memory over long documents.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors introduce the Sequence Order Recall Task. Given two non-overlapping 50-word passages sampled from a long text, the model or human subject must decide which one appeared earlier. They build a human behavioral dataset from memory of a full-length novel and compare it with long-context LLMs. The mechanistic part localizes temporal order information in model activations, then studies how this information is reinstated during retrieval. The paper reports that a specialized attention head retrieves a low-dimensional temporal code from the KV cache and that causal interventions on this mechanism affect order judgments. This distinguishes the proposed mechanism from a pure semantic-chain explanation.
summary_en.experiments: The reported findings are: models show the same distance effect observed in humans, where order judgments become easier as the two queried segments are farther apart in the original text; temporal order information can be localized in internal representations; and a specific attention head reinstates temporal information during retrieval and is causally involved in the task. The paper also releases ICMemory-Kit for long-context memory and interpretability experiments. The provided text does not include exact model sizes, context lengths, dataset sizes, or intervention effect sizes, so those numbers should be checked in the experimental sections.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the task and human dataset design to see how much semantic shortcutting is controlled. Then read the sections on temporal-code localization and attention-head causal intervention. The most important technical point is how the authors separate temporal context reinstatement from semantic inference. For engineering relevance, focus on the KV-cache analysis and the ICMemory-Kit design.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 方法论文，但如果你关心长上下文记忆机制，只看关键 head 干预和一维时间码那几节就够，能帮你判断 retrieval 到底像不像显式状态重建。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if long-context memory matters to you, read the head intervention and 1D temporal-code sections; they sharpen whether retrieval behaves like explicit state reinstatement.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: AdaRoPE: Not All Attention Heads Should Rotate and Scale Equally
paper.abstract: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) is widely adopted in Transformers to encode positional information, yet standard implementations enforce a uniform frequency schedule and scaling across all attention heads. Using simplified retrieval tasks and length generalization scenarios, we show -- both empirically and theoretically -- that heads with different functional roles require distinct frequency ranges and attention scaling factors to operate effectively. Ignoring this structure leads to suboptimal

summary.core_problem: 标准 RoPE 对所有 attention head 使用同一套频率表和缩放规则，可能不适合不同 head 在检索、位置建模和长上下文泛化中的不同功能分工。
summary.importance: 这是一个直接作用于 LLM 架构和长上下文预训练的改动。贡献不在于提出新的训练数据或 recipe，而是把 RoPE 的频率和 attention scaling 从全局固定设计改成 head-wise 可学习设计，挑战了“所有 head 共享同一位置编码谱”的默认做法。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用简化检索任务和长度泛化场景分析不同 head 对旋转频率范围和 attention 缩放因子的需求差异，再提出 AdaRoPE：为每个 attention head 配置可学习的 rotation frequencies 和 attention scaling factors。它属于对 RoPE 参数化方式的结构性改造，也可用于上下文扩展场景，修正 YaRN 等方法中的统一频率缩放和统一 attention 缩放假设。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖简化检索任务、长度泛化场景，以及采用 AdaRoPE 预训练的 LLM。摘要称 AdaRoPE 稳定优于已有 RoPE 变体，包括 partial RoPE 和 NoPE baseline；在上下文扩展中，统一频率和 attention scaling 的方法表现为次优。给定信息中未提供模型规模、训练 token 数和具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard RoPE applies the same frequency schedule and scaling rule to all attention heads, which may mismatch the different functional roles heads play in retrieval, position tracking, and long-context generalization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is directly relevant to LLM architecture and long-context pretraining. It changes the parameterization of positional encoding from a global fixed spectrum to head-wise learnable frequency and attention scaling, questioning the default assumption that all heads should share the same positional spectrum.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper analyzes simplified retrieval and length-generalization settings to show that heads need different frequency ranges and scaling factors. AdaRoPE then assigns learnable rotation frequencies and attention scaling factors to each attention head. The same idea is also applied to context extension, where it argues against uniform frequency and attention scaling used by methods such as YaRN.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments include synthetic retrieval tasks, length-generalization scenarios, and LLMs pretrained with AdaRoPE. The abstract reports consistent gains over RoPE variants including partial RoPE and NoPE baselines, and finds uniform scaling suboptimal for context extension. Model sizes, token budgets, and exact effect sizes are not available in the provided excerpt.

recommendation.zh: 头级 RoPE 参数化值得在长上下文预训练消融里复现；若收益只来自扩参，结论会打折。
recommendation.en: Head-wise RoPE parameterization is worth reproducing in long-context pretraining ablations; the claim weakens if the gain mostly comes from extra parameters.

paper.title: HeadCast: Casting Attention Heads for Efficient Autoregressive Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models have become a promising paradigm for long and streaming video synthesis, but the continuously growing Key-Value (KV) cache makes attention the dominant inference cost, especially at high resolution where each frame contributes many tokens. Existing remedies either evict the cache with coarse heuristics that cause inter-frame flickering, or require model re-training. We propose HeadCast, a training-free, plug-and-play acceleration framework built on the

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 AR video diffusion 在长视频和高分辨率推理时的 KV cache 膨胀问题。随着历史帧不断累积，注意力计算逐渐成为主要瓶颈。已有做法要么用统一滑窗，仍然很慢；要么激进驱逐缓存，容易丢掉长程依赖，出现 flicker 和结构漂移；要么需要重新训练模型。作者的问题设定很明确：能否不改模型参数，只根据预训练模型里不同 attention head 的稳定行为差异，给每个 head 分配不同的缓存和注意力路径，从而在不明显伤害时序一致性的前提下加速推理。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏推理效率，而不是预训练本身。对基座研究的直接价值有限，但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，它把“head specialization”从分析现象变成了可部署的系统优化，说明预训练模型内部确实存在稳定、可利用的结构异质性。第二，它针对 AR video diffusion 这种统一 Transformer 推理栈给出训练后改造方案，这对多模态统一模型、长上下文缓存管理、以及 head-level routing 的研究有参考意义。若关注纯文本 LLM 预训练，这篇不是优先级很高；若关注统一生成架构和 serving 侧结构利用，可以快速看。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 HeadCast。作者先观察预训练 AR 视频模型的注意力图，发现不同 head 在时间和空间维度上有稳定且异质的依赖模式，并将其分成四类。Sink head 主要盯住首帧或首个 block，起到锚点作用；Dummy head 主要看当前 denoising block；Spatial head 不需要全局历史，只需要跨历史帧的局部空间邻域；Global head 则确实依赖完整上下文。基于这个分类，HeadCast 在短暂 warm-up 后，只在最大噪声步 t=1000 做一次 head classification，因为此时注意力更反映结构偏好而不是具体内容。之后每类 head 走不同的计算路径：Sink 和 Dummy 只保留极小缓存，Spatial 在固定网格邻域内做注意力，Global 继续保留完整滑窗。对应地，原本统一的 KV cache 被拆成 head-specific buffers。这样做的关键不是一味裁剪，而是显式保留少数真正需要全局历史的 head，避免像 Dummy Forcing 那样因为分类过粗而把维持时序一致性的长程信息一起删掉。整个方法 training-free、plug-and-play，不需要改权重。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个 AR video diffusion 框架，包括 Self-Forcing、LongLive、Causal Forcing、Reward Forcing。主要结果是：加速收益会随着分辨率和缓存长度上升而变大，在 720P 上最高约 1.62×，在 1080P 上最高约 1.95×。质量方面，作者报告 VBench 指标基本保持，同时帧级保真度如 PSNR、LPIPS 也能维持，并且相较于更激进的缓存驱逐方法，明显减少 inter-frame flickering。论文的论证重点不只是平均指标，而是说明四类 head 的分工在生成过程中相对稳定，因此一次早期分类就足够；同时 ablation 也支持“必须保留 Global heads”这一点，否则时序一致性会明显下降。若从方法可信度看，最重要的证据是跨多个模型都能复用同一套分类-路由思路，而不是只在单一 backbone 上成立。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Motivation 和 Figure 1，理解四类 head 是怎么从时间稀疏和空间稀疏两个维度拆出来的。然后看 HeadCast 的流程图，重点弄清楚为什么分类只做一次、为什么选在最大噪声步、以及四类 head 各自保留什么缓存。实验部分优先看与 Dummy Forcing、滑窗基线的对比，以及关于 flicker 的可视化和 ablation。预计 20–30 分钟可以读完主线。若你做的是文本 LLM 预训练，可以把它当成“head specialization 是否足够稳定到能驱动系统优化”的案例；若你做多模态生成或 serving，这篇更值得细看实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the KV-cache growth problem in autoregressive video diffusion. As more video blocks are generated, historical keys and values accumulate, and attention over the cache becomes the dominant inference cost, especially at high resolution where each frame contributes many tokens. Existing fixes either use a uniform sliding window, which remains expensive, or aggressively evict cache entries, which harms long-range temporal consistency and causes flicker. Training-based sparse-attention alternatives require retraining. The paper asks whether a pretrained model’s attention heads have stable enough roles that each head can be given its own cache policy without changing model weights.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its direct relevance to language-model pretraining is modest. Still, it offers two useful lessons. First, head specialization is not just an interpretive observation; it can be stable enough to support deployment-time optimization. Second, it shows how a unified Transformer-style generative stack can be restructured after training by exploiting heterogeneous head behavior. That is relevant to multimodal foundation models, long-context cache management, and head-level routing ideas. For pure text pretraining, this is not a high-priority read; for unified generation systems and serving, it is more useful.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, HeadCast, starts from an empirical observation: attention heads in pretrained AR video models show stable and heterogeneous temporal/spatial dependency patterns. The authors group heads into four archetypes. Sink heads anchor strongly to the first frame or first block. Dummy heads attend almost entirely to the current denoising block. Spatial heads do not need the full history, only a local spatial neighborhood across historical frames. Global heads genuinely require broad historical context. After a short warm-up, HeadCast performs a one-time head classification at the maximum-noise step, t=1000, where attention is argued to reflect structural preference more than content-specific details. Each head is then routed to a dedicated computation path: Sink and Dummy heads keep only tiny buffers, Spatial heads attend within a fixed spatial grid, and Global heads retain the full sliding-window context. The monolithic KV cache is split into compact head-specific buffers. The key design choice is not merely pruning harder, but explicitly preserving the small subset of heads that carry long-range temporal dependencies, avoiding the temporal instability seen in coarser cache-eviction schemes such as Dummy Forcing. The method is training-free and plug-and-play.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans several AR video diffusion frameworks, including Self-Forcing, LongLive, Causal Forcing, and Reward Forcing. The main result is that speedup grows with resolution and cache size: up to about 1.62x at 720P and 1.95x at 1080P. On quality, the paper reports preserved VBench performance together with stable frame-level fidelity metrics such as PSNR and LPIPS. Qualitatively, it reduces inter-frame flickering compared with more aggressive cache-eviction baselines. A central empirical point is that the four head archetypes remain stable enough during generation that a single early classification is sufficient. The ablations also support the need to retain Global heads; removing or over-pruning them degrades temporal coherence. The strongest evidence is not a single benchmark win, but the fact that the same classify-and-route idea transfers across multiple pretrained AR video generators.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, begin with the motivation section and the first attention visualizations. They explain how the four head types emerge from temporal sparsity and spatial sparsity. Then read the HeadCast pipeline carefully, focusing on three questions: why classification is done only once, why it is done at the maximum-noise step, and what cache each head type keeps. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against sliding-window baselines and Dummy Forcing, plus the flicker visualizations and the ablations on Global-head retention. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough for the main idea. If your work is in text LLM pretraining, treat this as a case study in whether head specialization is stable enough to drive systems optimization; if you work on multimodal generation or serving, the implementation details are more worth studying.

recommendation.zh: 面向视频AR扩散的KV cache头分型思路可迁移到长上下文LLM；只看§3的头分类定义和消融图即可，视频生成细节可跳过。
recommendation.en: The head-typed KV cache idea transfers to long-context LLM inference; read §3 head taxonomy and ablations, skip video-specific generation details.

paper.title: Data-Efficient Adaptation of LLMs via Attention Head Reweighting
paper.abstract: Learning effectively from limited data is critical in domains like security where labeled examples are scarce. Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated some capabilities for data-efficient learning, especially through parameter-efficient adaptation methods, but continue to struggle when faced with few samples for difficult tasks. To meet this challenge, we propose Attention Head Reweighting (AHR), a data-efficient method that adapts LLMs to new text-classification tasks by learning only a

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 在少样本文本分类任务上微调成本高、LoRA 等方法仍容易过拟合或数据效率不足的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是参数高效适配方法：只学习每个 attention head 一个标量，试图利用注意力头的功能分工，在极少训练参数下完成任务适配。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Attention Head Reweighting，将每个注意力头的输出乘以可学习权重，而不是更新低秩矩阵或大块模型参数。它是对已有 PEFT 思路的更强约束版本，核心假设是少样本任务主要需要重新组合已有 head 功能，而非学习新表示。
summary.experiments: 在多个开源文本分类数据集上，与 LoRA 等参数高效微调基线比较；摘要称 AHR 在少样本条件下可优于 LoRA，训练参数少 200-1000 倍，仅修改约 0.0001% 参数。摘要未提供具体模型规模和逐任务数字。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 UC San Diego 和 Microsoft Research；Jianfeng Gao 是微软 NLP 与大模型方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets data-efficient adaptation of LLMs for few-shot text classification, where standard PEFT methods can still be parameter-heavy or sample-inefficient.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a highly constrained PEFT method that learns one scalar per attention head, using the presumed functional specialization of heads for task adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Attention Head Reweighting multiplies each attention head output by a learned scalar instead of updating low-rank adapters or larger parameter blocks. The method assumes that few-shot adaptation can often be achieved by recombining existing head functions rather than learning new representations.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments on diverse open-source text classification datasets, comparing against baselines such as LoRA. The abstract claims better few-shot performance with 200-1000x fewer trainable parameters and about 0.0001% of model parameters updated, but does not provide exact model sizes or task-level numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from UC San Diego and Microsoft Research; Jianfeng Gao is a well-known researcher in NLP and large language models.

recommendation.zh: 这是 PEFT 的强约束小技巧，结论若成立说明 head 组合有用；看实验表即可，不是基座训练方法。
recommendation.en: A tightly constrained PEFT trick; if the result holds, it says head recomposition matters, but reading the result tables is enough.

paper.title: Toward Localizing and Repairing Bias in Transformer Attention Heads
paper.abstract: Transformer language models are increasingly used as software components, yet biased outputs remain difficult to localize and repair inside the model. Existing fairness testing and repair methods largely operate at the input-output or retraining level, while recent work suggests that bias-related behavior can concentrate in a small set of attention heads. This paper studies whether attention heads can be localized and repaired through a targeted inference-time intervention. We introduce ROBIN, a

summary.core_problem: 研究 Transformer 语言模型中的偏见行为能否被定位到少量 attention heads，并通过推理时的局部干预进行修复。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是可解释性与安全修复的初步方法；它把公平性问题从输入输出层面推进到模型内部 head-level 调试，但实验规模是 pilot study，结论需要谨慎看待。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ROBIN，一种白盒 head-level fairness debugging 方法：先用 fairness probes 评估各 attention head 对偏见指标的敏感性，再从选中 head 的输出中移除一个小的 bias subspace；它不是整头置零，而是对子空间做局部投影式修正。
summary.experiments: 在四个 Transformer 语言模型上做初步实验，ROBIN 在所有模型上降低 WinoBias gap，并且相比 whole-head zeroing 更好地保留语言建模质量；摘要未给出模型规模、具体 baseline 列表或提升数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether biased behavior in Transformer language models can be localized to specific attention heads and repaired through targeted inference-time interventions.
summary_en.importance: It is an interpretability and safety-repair contribution. The useful part is the move from input-output fairness testing toward head-level white-box debugging, although the evidence is still a small pilot study.
summary_en.technical_approach: ROBIN ranks attention heads by their sensitivity to fairness probes, then removes a small bias subspace from the outputs of selected heads. The key design choice is subspace removal rather than zeroing out entire heads.
summary_en.experiments: A four-model pilot study reports reduced WinoBias gaps across all models while preserving language-modeling quality better than whole-head zeroing. The abstract does not provide model sizes, exact baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和 WinoBias 结果即可；pilot 规模太小，但“修子空间而非删 head”是个可复用干预思路。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and WinoBias table only; the pilot is small, but subspace repair instead of head deletion is a reusable intervention idea.

paper.title: Vision-Default, Prior-Override: Causal Mechanisms of Perception-Knowledge Conflict in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models must reconcile visual evidence with memorized world knowledge when the two conflict. How they resolve this conflict shapes the reliability of multimodal systems, yet prior work characterizes it behaviorally without a component-level causal account. We combine activation patching across three granularities (residual stream, attention heads, and MLP sublayers) with model-component ablation studies and mechanistic analysis. Across three VLM families, we find that visual groun

summary.core_problem: 解释 VLM 在视觉证据与记忆中的先验知识冲突时，究竟由哪些组件决定模型更信图像还是更信先验。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，不是新模型。价值在于把“视觉优先还是知识优先”从行为现象推进到组件级因果解释，对多模态统一预训练和对齐阶段的表征分工有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者结合 activation patching、按残差流/注意力头/MLP 子层三种粒度的干预，以及组件消融，分析三类 VLM 家族在 perception-knowledge conflict 下的因果路径。核心发现是：视觉 grounding 是默认态，而调用记忆先验依赖网络后半段一小撮因果必要的 attention heads。
summary.experiments: 覆盖三个 VLM 家族。论文报告仅 2.5%-4.8% 的注意力头对 prior grounding 具有因果必要性；消融这些头后，在 prior-knowledge prompts 下，68%-96% 的知识驱动回答会翻转为视觉驱动，而原本视觉驱动的预测只变化 0.8%-7.5%。这说明两种 grounding 机制并不对称。
summary.authors_note: University of Tübingen、Harvard University、The University of Texas at Austin。属于较扎实的 VLM 机制分析路线，但从公开信息看并非顶级实验室的大规模预训练项目。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which internal components make a VLM follow visual evidence versus memorized prior knowledge when the two conflict.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis rather than a new model. Its value is in moving the question from behavioral observation to component-level causal attribution, which matters for multimodal pretraining and alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors combine activation patching, interventions at three granularities (residual stream, attention heads, and MLP sublayers), and ablations across three VLM families. The key claim is that visual grounding is the default mode, while prior grounding depends on a small set of causally necessary attention heads in the later half of the network.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans three VLM families. It reports that only 2.5%-4.8% of attention heads are causally necessary for prior grounding; ablating them flips 68%-96% of knowledge-grounded answers to visually grounded ones under prior-knowledge prompts, while changing only 0.8%-7.5% of already visually grounded predictions.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Tübingen, Harvard University, and The University of Texas at Austin. This looks like a solid mechanistic VLM study, though not a flagship pretraining effort from a major frontier lab.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你对 VLM 冲突解析的 prior：先看消融结果和头部定位，若现象稳，后续可直接拿来做 multimodal routing/regularization 假设。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining recipes, but it may change your prior on VLM conflict resolution: read the head-level causal ablations first, then decide whether to turn it into routing or regularization hypotheses.

institutions: The University of Texas at Austin

paper.title: Robust Harmful Features Under Jailbreak Attacks: Mechanistic Evidence from Attention Head Specialization in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Jailbreak attacks bypass LLM safety alignment, yet their mechanisms remain poorly understood. We provide evidence that attacks do not comprehensively eliminate safety features, but instead selectively suppress specific attention heads. We identify two functionally differentiated types: Adversarially Compromised Heads (ACHs) concentrated in early layers, which are suppressed under attacks, and Safety-Aligned Heads (SAHs) in mid-layers, which maintain robust activations even when attacks succeed.

summary.core_problem: 解释 jailbreak 攻击为何能绕过 LLM 的拒答行为：攻击是否真的抹除了安全特征，还是只干扰了部分关键计算路径。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析。它把安全对齐失效拆到 attention head 层面，区分被攻击模板抑制的早层头和仍保持安全激活的中层头，对理解 post-train safety 信号如何嵌入基座有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文识别两类功能分化的注意力头：早层的 Adversarially Compromised Heads 在攻击下被抑制，中层的 Safety-Aligned Heads 在攻击成功时仍保持激活。通过 head ablation、激活比较和 token-level attribution 验证因果关系，并追踪攻击模板 token 对 ACH 抑制的贡献。
summary.experiments: 摘要未说明具体模型、数据集和攻击集规模。核心实验证据包括：抑制少量 ACH 可让正常应拒答输入出现 jailbreak-like 行为；移除 SAH 会削弱中层安全激活；token attribution 显示攻击模板 token 是 ACH 抑制的主要来源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why jailbreak attacks bypass refusal behavior in LLMs: do they erase safety features globally, or do they selectively disrupt specific computation paths?
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic safety analysis. It localizes jailbreak effects to specialized attention heads and is relevant for understanding how post-training safety signals are represented inside a pretrained model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors identify two head types: early-layer Adversarially Compromised Heads, whose activations are suppressed by attacks, and mid-layer Safety-Aligned Heads, which remain active even when the attack succeeds. They use head ablations, activation analysis, and token-level attribution to test causality.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model families, datasets, or attack suites. Reported evidence includes inducing jailbreak-like behavior by suppressing a small number of ACHs, weakening safety activations by removing SAHs, and attributing ACH suppression to attack-template tokens.

recommendation.zh: 只看 head 分型和 ablation；若 setup 干净，它会修正“jailbreak 抹掉安全表征”的粗糙 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the head taxonomy and ablations; if the setup is clean, it refines the crude prior that jailbreaks simply erase safety representations.

paper.title: CompressKV: Semantic-Retrieval-Guided KV-Cache Compression for Resource-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference
paper.abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly constrained by the memory footprint and decoding cost of key-value (KV) caches, limiting sustainable deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Existing KV cache eviction methods typically apply heuristic token scoring over all heads in GQA-based LLMs. These methods ignore the different functionalities of attention heads, leading to the eviction of critical tokens and thus degrading the performance of LLMs. To address this issue

summary.core_problem: 现有基于注意力分数的 KV cache 驱逐方法在 GQA 架构上对所有 head 做均等聚合，忽视了 head 功能异质性，导致偏向保留 prompt 首尾的 Streaming Heads 主导打分，中间语义关键 token 被误驱逐；同时各层 KV 预算要么固定均分，要么依赖在线统计，泛化性和开销都不理想。
summary.importance: 属于推理效率方向的增量工作，主要价值在于再次明确指出 GQA 下 head 异质性对 KV 压缩策略的影响，并给出一个基于离线层误差分配预算的实用方案。对 pretrain 研究的直接启发有限，但对理解 attention head 分工、长上下文推理时的信息保留机制有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CompressKV，分三步：(1) 离线识别 Semantic Retrieval Heads（SRHs），即能同时关注 prompt 首尾 token 及其周边语义上下文的 head，而不是只盯住首尾的 Streaming Heads；(2) 在每层内仅用 SRHs 的注意力分数来选择重要 token，并在该层的所有 head 间共享同一套保留 token 索引，避免 Streaming Heads 主导驱逐决策；(3) 离线计算每层在压缩前后 attention block 输出差的 Frobenius 范数，以此估计该层对压缩误差的敏感度，按比例分配各层 KV 预算，不引入在线开销。
summary.experiments: 在 LongBench 和 Needle-in-a-Haystack 上评测多个 GQA LLM。LongBench 上以 19% KV 预算保留超过 99% 的全 cache 性能，3% 预算下保留约 97% 的 QA 准确率；NIAH 上以 0.7% KV 存储达到 90% 的基线检索准确率。实验验证了 SRH 选择和离线层自适应分配两个组件各自有效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看方法部分对 Streaming Heads 与 Semantic Retrieval Heads 的区分、以及基于 Frobenius 范数做离线层预算分配的思路。图 1 关于 head 异质性导致误驱逐的示意比较直观。预计阅读时间 15–20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing attention-score-based KV cache eviction methods for GQA models aggregate scores uniformly across heads, ignoring functional heterogeneity across attention heads. As a result, Streaming Heads that focus primarily on the beginning and end of the prompt dominate eviction decisions, causing semantically important mid-context tokens to be discarded. Existing layer budget allocation is either fixed across layers or relies on online statistics with limited generalization and non-trivial overhead.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental inference-efficiency paper. Its main value is in making the head-heterogeneity problem in GQA-based KV compression explicit and providing a practical, offline layer-budget allocation scheme. Its direct implications for pretraining are limited, but it offers useful observations on attention head specialization and information retention in long-context inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: CompressKV consists of three steps: (1) offline identification of Semantic Retrieval Heads (SRHs), i.e., heads that retrieve important mid-prompt tokens and attend to their semantic context, as opposed to Streaming Heads that mostly attend to initial and final tokens; (2) important-token selection based only on SRH attention scores within each layer, with a single set of preserved token indices shared across all heads in that layer, so that eviction is no longer dominated by Streaming Heads; (3) offline error-aware layer budget allocation, where the Frobenius norm of the attention-block output difference between full and compressed cache is used to estimate per-layer compression sensitivity, and budgets are allocated proportionally without online overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongBench and Needle-in-a-Haystack across multiple GQA LLMs. On LongBench, CompressKV retains over 99% of full-cache performance with 19% KV budget and about 97% QA accuracy with 3% budget. On NIAH, it reaches 90% of baseline retrieval accuracy with only 0.7% KV storage. Ablations support the contribution of both SRH-based token selection and offline layer-adaptive allocation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the distinction between Streaming Heads and Semantic Retrieval Heads, and on the offline Frobenius-based layer budget allocation idea. Figure 1 gives a clear illustration of how head heterogeneity causes incorrect eviction. Estimated reading time: 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 SRH 识别和 layer budget ablation；若只在少数长文任务上有效，不要过度外推到训练期 head 分工。
recommendation.en: Read the SRH identification and layer-budget ablations; if gains are task-narrow, do not overread them as training-time head specialization.

paper.title: Mind the Heads: Topological Representation Alignment for Multimodal LLMs
paper.abstract: Representation alignment has emerged as an effective approach to improve Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) by regularizing their internal representations toward those of an external vision encoder. However, existing methods typically align a fixed layer of the language backbone, overlooking the fine-grained structure of Transformer models. In this work, we propose Head-Wise Representation Alignment (HeRA), a method that enforces cross-modal alignment at the level of individual attention h

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是 MLLM 内部视觉-语言表示对齐过粗的问题。已有方法通常选择语言模型某一层的整体 hidden state 去对齐外部视觉编码器，但 Transformer 的表征并不是按“层”均匀组织的，不同 attention head 可能承载不同程度的跨模态结构。论文关心的是：视觉能力不足是否可以通过更细粒度地约束这些 head 的局部几何结构来改善，而不是继续只靠扩大数据、模型或后训练。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接贡献不在文本 LM，而在 VLM/MLLM 的统一表示训练接口。它把 representation alignment 从 feature matching 推向 topology matching：不要求语言侧向量逐点接近视觉侧向量，而是要求样本之间的局部邻域关系一致。这一点对 multimodal pretrain 有启发，因为 MLLM 常常是在已有 LLM 上接入视觉模块，强行对齐特征值可能破坏语言模型已有组织；对齐局部结构更像一种软约束，可能更适合在保留语言能力的同时补视觉感知短板。贡献量级属于方法性增量，但选 head 的诊断思路比较清楚。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 HeRA，即 Head-Wise Representation Alignment。核心流程有三步。第一，用外部 teacher vision encoder 提取图像表示，用语言模型内部不同 attention head 的表示作为候选语言侧表示。第二，用 Mutual K-Nearest Neighbor, MKNN, 衡量两侧表示的局部邻域是否一致。MKNN 不比较绝对坐标，而比较一个样本在两个表征空间里的近邻集合是否相互匹配。第三，不是选择最已经对齐的 head，而是选择最不对齐的 head 加入对比式 alignment loss。这个设计有明确取舍：已经对齐的 head 再施加强约束收益有限，还可能干扰原有功能；低对齐 head 更可能是跨模态瓶颈，适合用额外损失修正。训练目标是在原有 autoregressive token NLL 之外，加入一个可微的拓扑对齐代理目标，让被选中的 head 学到与视觉 teacher 相近的局部结构。它区别于固定层对齐，也区别于直接 MSE/feature regression，因为后者容易把语言模型表示拉向视觉编码器的坐标系，冲突更强。
summary.experiments: 实验放在 LLaVA 类框架下，覆盖多个 MLLM，并在 18 个视觉-语言 benchmark 上评估。论文报告 HeRA 在更依赖视觉感知的任务上收益更稳定，包括物体存在性、计数、空间关系、密集视觉信息解析等场景；普通 VQA 能力没有明显牺牲，部分设置还有提升。另一个观察是 hallucination 有下降，解释是拓扑对齐降低了模型只依赖语言先验补全答案的倾向。给出的材料没有包含完整表格和逐项数值，因此不应只看平均分；更应关注不同 head 选择策略、不同层/头的 MKNN 分布、以及 hallucination benchmark 上的分项变化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看三处：一是方法部分里 MKNN 如何从诊断指标转成训练损失；二是 head selection 的消融，尤其是 least-aligned heads 为什么优于 most-aligned 或 random heads；三是视觉中心任务与 hallucination 评测结果。若只关心预训练启发，可以跳过常规 VQA 榜单细节，把注意力放在“在已有 LLM 组织结构上施加跨模态约束”的设计取舍。这个方向值得深挖的问题是：head-level 拓扑对齐是否能扩展到更早期的 native multimodal pretraining，而不是只在 LLaVA 式后接视觉模块上生效。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a granularity problem in representation alignment for MLLMs. Prior work usually aligns a fixed layer-level hidden state of the language backbone to an external vision encoder. This ignores the fact that Transformer representations are organized unevenly across attention heads. The paper asks whether visual-language alignment can be improved by targeting the specific heads whose local geometry is poorly aligned with the visual teacher.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance is to multimodal pretraining and adaptation rather than text-only LM pretraining. The useful idea is to align topology instead of raw features. In an MLLM built on a pretrained LLM, forcing hidden states to match a vision encoder coordinate-by-coordinate can interfere with the language model’s existing structure. Preserving local neighborhood relations is a softer constraint and may be a better fit for improving perception while retaining language behavior. The contribution is a focused methodological improvement, with a clear diagnostic-and-training loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: HeRA, or Head-Wise Representation Alignment, first measures alignment between individual attention-head representations and a teacher vision encoder using Mutual K-Nearest Neighbor alignment. MKNN compares whether samples share similar local neighborhoods in the two representation spaces, rather than comparing vector coordinates directly. HeRA then selects the least aligned heads and applies a contrastive alignment loss to them, alongside the standard autoregressive token likelihood. The choice of least aligned heads is important: already aligned heads are likely to offer limited gain and stronger risk of disrupting useful structure, while poorly aligned heads are plausible bottlenecks for cross-modal reasoning. Compared with fixed-layer alignment or direct feature regression, the method is more fine-grained and less rigid.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted under the LLaVA-style MLLM framework across multiple model variants and 18 vision-language benchmarks. The reported pattern is consistent improvement on visually demanding tasks, including object presence, counting, spatial relation understanding, and dense visual parsing. General VQA performance is not degraded and often improves. The paper also reports reduced visual hallucination, which is consistent with the view that topological alignment weakens over-reliance on language priors. The provided material does not include the complete numerical tables, so the most informative evidence is likely in the head-selection ablations, MKNN distributions, and hallucination-specific evaluations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Focus on the definition of the MKNN-based objective, the ablation comparing least-aligned, most-aligned, and random head selection, and the results on visual-centric and hallucination benchmarks. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful part is the design principle: impose cross-modal constraints at the level where the pretrained LLM has heterogeneous internal organization, instead of treating a whole layer as a uniform representation.

recommendation.zh: 头级别跨模态对齐的思路可迁移至多模态预训练对齐模块设计，重点读方法部分的HeRA损失定义和注意力头选择策略
recommendation.en: The head-wise cross-modal alignment idea is transferable to multimodal pretraining alignment module design; focus on the method section for HeRA loss definition and attention head selection strategy

paper.title: Complementary Attention Head Pruning for Efficient Transformers
paper.abstract: The remarkable success of Transformer-based models in natural language processing stems from architectural scaling, which leads to a large number of parameters and hinders deployment in resource-constrained environments. While structured pruning offers a pathway to compression, existing state-of-the-art methods often rely on gradient-based importance ranking or stochastic gating, which suffer from instability, structural degeneration, and the need for extensive manual hyperparameter tuning.
