summary.core_problem: 现有Transformer注意力头结构化剪枝方法多基于梯度重要性排序或随机门，存在训练不稳定、结构退化、需大量超参调优的问题，且孤立评估头的重要性而忽略功能互补性。
summary.importance: 提出一种无需预定义稀疏度的后处理注意力头剪枝框架，属于高效推理方向的方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CAHP框架，将注意力头选择建模为全局图论问题：1）用信息论距离度量头之间的功能相似度构建无向图；2）图聚类识别拓扑多样的互补头子集；3）自动确定剪枝数量，无需预设稀疏比或额外重训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要未完整披露实验所用的模型参数量、数据集、基准剪枝方法与性能-效率trade-off结果，核心贡献为剪枝框架设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing structured attention head pruning methods for Transformers mostly rely on gradient-based importance ranking or stochastic gating, suffering from instability, structural degeneration, hyperparameter tuning overhead, and ignoring functional complementarity between heads.
summary_en.importance: A post-hoc attention head pruning framework that eliminates predefined sparsity requirements, a methodological improvement in the efficient inference direction.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CAHP framework, which formulates attention head selection as a global graph-theoretic problem: 1) Build an undirected graph using information-theoretic distances to measure functional similarity between heads; 2) Use graph clustering to identify topologically diverse subsets of complementary heads; 3) Automatically determine pruning count without preset sparsity ratios or retraining.
summary_en.experiments: Model scale, datasets, baseline pruning methods, and performance-efficiency trade-off results are not fully disclosed in the abstract; core contribution is pruning framework design.

recommendation.zh: 增量式的注意力头剪枝方法，仅需了解其基于互补性的全局选择思路，作为剪枝领域的literature备查即可，无需复现。
recommendation.en: An incremental attention head pruning method; only the complementarity-based global selection idea is worth noting, for pruning literature reference, no reproduction needed.

paper.title: A Mechanistic Understanding of Pronoun Fidelity in LLMs
paper.abstract: Faithful and robust pronoun use is important for fair and coherent generations, yet large language models largely fail when multiple referents use different pronouns. To study the interplay of reasoning, repetition, and bias in this task, prior work relies exclusively on behavioural approaches, which may not reflect a model's internal workings. Therefore, we provide a mechanistic, model-internal perspective on pronoun fidelity, testing whether three mechanisms -- group entity binding (G), recenc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是 pronoun fidelity 的内部机制，而不是再做一层行为学归因。具体问题是：当上下文里有多个 referent、不同 pronoun、以及职业刻板印象等干扰时，LLM 最终输出某个代词，到底是因为真正绑定了实体与代词，还是因为偏向最近出现的代词，或者沿用了职业相关的性别刻板印象。作者要回答的不是“模型表现差不差”，而是这些候选机制是否以可干预、可分离的因果子空间形式存在于模型内部，以及它们如何竞争地影响最终预测。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究不是直接的方法论文，但有两点启发很实在。第一，它展示了一个较完整的 mechanistic 路线：把行为假设改写成内部因果假设，再用可交换干预去验证。这种做法对分析预训练模型里的 shortcut、偏置来源、以及表示是否真的学到结构化绑定关系很有参考价值。第二，pronoun fidelity 这个任务虽然表面上是 fairness/consistency 问题，底层其实触及语言模型是否学会 entity binding、长程依赖保持、以及语义复制与表面复制的竞争。这些都是预训练目标能否诱导出稳定表示的重要问题。它不是直接改进 pretrain recipe 的工作，但对理解模型内部表示失败在哪里有帮助。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是用 Boundless Distributed Alignment Search 去找三类候选机制在 residual stream 中的因果子空间。作者把先前行为研究里的三种解释，重写成 mechanistic hypotheses：G 表示 group entity binding，即模型是否把“实体+其 pronoun”作为一个绑定单元来检索；R 表示 recency bias，即是否更容易复制最近出现的 pronoun；S 表示 stereotypical bias，即是否受职业-性别统计关联驱动。

DAS 的基本思想是：在某一层 residual representation 上学习一个正交旋转，把高层概念对应的信息压到某个可识别子空间里；然后做 interchange intervention，把 source 输入中的该子空间替换进 base 输入，观察输出是否按预期改变。如果替换后输出跟高层因果假设一致，就说明这个子空间在因果上承载了该机制。Boundless DAS 进一步把子空间维度 k 也做成可学习的软边界，而不是手工枚举。

这篇工作的价值在于它不是只找“有没有一个 pronoun neuron/head”，而是把机制视为 distributed subspace，并且允许多个机制同时存在。作者发现三种机制都能在不同深度找到因果子空间，没有任何一种单独解释全部行为。进一步，他们把这些机制组合成 mixture model，可以解释绝大多数模型行为。

除了 DAS，作者还做了 attention head 分析，发现 pronoun 信息到达答案位置主要有两条竞争路径：一条复制 occupation-pronoun pair 这样的语义绑定单元，另一条更像表面形式复制，直接沿最近或显著的 pronoun token 传播。这个分析把“为什么模型会在某些例子里忠实、在另一些例子里失真”讲得更细：不是单一模块失效，而是多条回路竞争，哪条回路占优取决于上下文结构和模型偏置。

实验对象覆盖十个 instruction-tuned decoder-only 模型，来自 Llama-3.1、Gemma-2、Qwen2.5、OLMo-2 四个家族，规模从 1B 到 72B。评测时不是直接看自由生成，而是比较 pronoun 选项的 log-prob，避免无关 token 抢占概率质量。这个设计更适合做机制分析，因为它把输出空间限制在真正关心的 pronoun 决策上。
summary.experiments:
关键结果有三类。第一，三种机制 G、R、S 都能通过 Boundless DAS 找到对应的因果子空间，而且这些子空间分布在网络不同深度，不是集中在单层单点。第二，没有任何单一机制足以解释模型行为，但把几种机制组合成 mixture model 后，可以预测 91% 到 99.5% 的行为。这说明 pronoun fidelity 失败不是“模型只会 recency”这么简单，而是多个机制同时活跃、相互竞争。第三，attention 分析显示存在两条复制路径：语义绑定复制与表面形式复制。前者更接近正确的 referent-pronoun 追踪，后者更容易导致最近项干扰或刻板印象放大。

数据方面，作者基于 RUFF 诊断集构造了用于隔离不同机制的 counterfactual 输入。RUFF 本身有超过 500 万实例，原始行为研究已经显示：加入一个带不同 pronoun 的干扰实体后，模型准确率会显著下降，文中引用的降幅可达 34%。这篇工作不是重新追求更高任务分数，而是用这些结构化对照样本训练和验证 DAS。

从基座研究视角，最值得看的不是哪家模型最好，而是两个模式：一是机制在不同模型家族中都共存，说明这不是某个架构偶然学到的坏习惯；二是机制分布跨层而非局部化，意味着简单地 patch 单个 head 或单层表示，未必能系统修复 pronoun fidelity。若要进一步利用这篇工作，应该关注附录里不同模型、不同层、不同子空间大小的 IIA 结果，以及 mixture model 在各家模型上的权重差异。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。先看 Introduction 和任务定义，明确 pronoun fidelity 不是一般的 coreference benchmark，而是一个很干净的最小化设置，用来分离绑定、最近项复制和刻板印象偏置。

方法部分重点看 DAS / Boundless DAS 的设定。需要弄清三件事：高层因果假设如何转成 source-base-counterfactual 三元组；rotation 和 soft boundary 如何学习；Interchange Intervention Accuracy 如何解释。只要这三点明白，后面的结果就容易读。

实验部分优先看三张内容：1）各机制的 IIA 结果和层分布；2）mixture model 对行为的解释率；3）attention head 分析图，尤其两条复制路径的证据。如果时间有限，可以不细读所有模型家族的逐项结果，先看作者是否证明了“多机制共存且可分离”这一主结论。

如果想把它和预训练研究联系起来，建议重点思考两个问题：为什么标准 next-token 目标会同时学出 entity binding 与 surface-copy shortcut；以及这种竞争能否通过数据构造、训练目标或中期干预被重新平衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a mechanistic question about pronoun fidelity: when an LM chooses a pronoun in contexts with multiple referents, conflicting pronouns, and occupational stereotypes, what internal mechanism is actually driving the prediction? Is the model retrieving a bound entity-pronoun representation, copying the most recent pronoun, or following a stereotype-linked prior? Prior work studied this behaviorally. This paper tries to identify whether these candidate explanations exist as causal, separable subspaces inside the model and how they compete during generation.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is still useful for foundation-model researchers. First, it is a good example of turning behavioral hypotheses into internal causal hypotheses and testing them with interventions rather than correlations. That template is relevant for studying shortcuts, bias pathways, and whether pretraining really induces structured binding. Second, pronoun fidelity is a narrow task on the surface, but underneath it probes entity binding, long-range consistency, and the competition between semantic retrieval and surface-form copying. Those are central questions for understanding what next-token pretraining does and does not teach models to represent robustly.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main tool is Boundless Distributed Alignment Search (DAS). The authors formalize three candidate mechanisms as mechanistic hypotheses: G for group entity binding, where the model retrieves an entity together with its associated pronoun; R for recency bias, where the model prefers the most recently seen pronoun; and S for stereotypical bias, where occupation-linked gender associations influence the prediction.

DAS works by learning an orthogonal rotation of the residual stream at a chosen layer so that a high-level concept becomes localized in a subspace. The method then performs interchange interventions: it takes a base input, swaps in the learned subspace from a source input, rotates back, and checks whether the output changes in the way predicted by the causal hypothesis. If it does, that subspace is treated as causally carrying the mechanism. Boundless DAS extends this by learning the effective subspace size with differentiable soft boundaries instead of manually searching over dimensions.

A strong point of the paper is that it does not look for a single neuron or a single head. It treats mechanisms as distributed subspaces and allows multiple mechanisms to coexist. The results support exactly that picture: all three mechanisms are present, distributed across depth, and none alone explains the full behavior.

The paper also adds an attention-head analysis. It finds two competing routes by which pronoun information reaches the answer position. One route copies an occupation-pronoun pair as a semantic unit, which is closer to correct referent tracking. The other route copies the surface form more directly, which makes the model vulnerable to recency effects and stereotypical interference. This gives a more concrete circuit-level story for why the same model can be faithful in some contexts and fail badly in others.

The experiments cover ten instruction-tuned decoder-only models from four families: Llama-3.1, Gemma-2, Qwen2.5, and OLMo-2, ranging from 1B to 72B. Outputs are scored by comparing log-probabilities over pronoun options rather than unrestricted generation, which is a sensible choice for mechanism analysis because it isolates the pronoun decision itself.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main findings. First, all three mechanisms—group entity binding, recency bias, and stereotypical bias—can be recovered as causal subspaces with Boundless DAS, and these subspaces are distributed across model depth rather than localized to a single layer. Second, no single mechanism explains model behavior on its own, but a mixture model combining them predicts 91% to 99.5% of behavior. That is the central empirical result: pronoun fidelity is not governed by one dominant heuristic, but by multiple simultaneously active mechanisms. Third, the attention analysis identifies two competing copying pathways, one semantic and one surface-form based, which helps explain when models stay faithful and when they drift.

The study builds diagnostic counterfactual datasets from RUFF, a pronoun-fidelity dataset with more than 5 million instances. Earlier behavioral work had already shown that adding a single distractor entity with a different pronoun can reduce accuracy sharply, with a cited drop of up to 34%. This paper uses that structured setup not to improve task accuracy, but to train and validate causal interventions.

For a foundation-model reader, the most useful pattern is not which model family scores highest. It is that the same three mechanisms appear across families and scales, suggesting that these are not isolated quirks of one architecture. Another useful point is that the mechanisms are distributed, which implies that patching one head or one layer is unlikely to fully fix the problem. The appendix is likely where the most informative details live: layerwise IIA, learned subspace sizes, and how the mixture weights differ across model families.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper and can be read in about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with the task setup. The important point is that pronoun fidelity is a deliberately minimal setting designed to separate entity binding, recency copying, and stereotype effects, not just another coreference benchmark.

In the method section, focus on DAS and Boundless DAS. Three things matter: how the high-level causal hypotheses are converted into base/source/counterfactual examples, how the rotation and soft boundaries are learned, and how to interpret Interchange Intervention Accuracy. Once those are clear, the rest of the paper becomes much easier to follow.

In the experiments, prioritize the layerwise IIA results for the three mechanisms, the mixture-model explanation rate, and the attention-head evidence for the two copying routes. If time is short, you can skip many of the per-model details and just verify the main claim that multiple separable mechanisms coexist and jointly explain behavior.

The two follow-up questions worth carrying into pretraining research are: why standard next-token training learns both entity-binding behavior and shallow surface-copy shortcuts at the same time, and whether data design, objective changes, or mid-training interventions could shift that balance toward more robust binding.

recommendation.zh: 看因果子空间和 attention route 两节；结论对训练不直接给 recipe，但能校正简单“偏见=表层统计”的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the causal-subspace and attention-route sections; it gives no training recipe, but it usefully corrects the simple 'bias equals surface statistics' prior.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的是：VLM 在生成描述时，语言 backbone 内部到底是怎样把“当前正在说的文字”对齐到“当前正在看的图像区域”的。作者不是泛泛地找“看图的头”，而是找一类更具体的机制性 attention heads：它们会随着生成过程逐 token 切换关注区域，去跟踪模型此刻正在描述的那一块视觉内容。更进一步，作者要验证这类头不只是相关，而是对“描述哪一块”具有因果控制力。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心推进，更接近 VLM 机制分析与可控生成研究。但对做原生多模态预训练的人有两点启发。第一，视觉 grounding 在语言 backbone 里可能被压缩到一小簇中后层 attention heads，而不是均匀分布在全网，这对架构设计、adapter 放置、蒸馏和稀疏干预都有意义。第二，图文对齐并不只是 encoder 侧表征问题，decoder/backbone 内部存在可定位、可操纵的时序路由机制。这个观察对理解多模态 token 如何进入统一 LM 很有价值，不过论文本身更偏 interpretability，贡献量级适合 skim，不属于 must-read 的 pretrain 方法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分三步。第一步是定位“阅读顺序/视觉叙述顺序”在网络中的层位置。作者用六格漫画作为受控环境，因为 panel 的空间顺序天然对应叙述顺序。对同一张 strip，分别给正常提示和“reverse”提示，让模型按相反顺序读取，并在回答前的残差流上做 difference-of-means，得到一个 per-layer 的 read-in-reverse direction。然后把这个方向注入新前向过程的某一层，观察答案是否从正常顺序翻到反向顺序。结果显示只有 20–28 层这一窄带有效，说明顺序控制主要局部化在中后层。

第二步是在这些层里找具体的 gaze heads。作者定义了一个简单的相关性分数：看某个 head 在生成某段文本时，其 attention 是否稳定落在当前被描述的 panel 区域，并随叙述推进而切换。发现 Qwen3-VL-8B 的 1152 个头里，大约 100 个头满足这一性质，占 8.7%，集中在中后层。这个发现还在 2B 到 32B 的不同尺寸和其他 VLM 架构上复现，说明它不是单模型偶然现象。

第三步是做因果干预。作者不训练额外模块，而是在推理时直接修改这些 gaze heads 的 attention mask，把它们重定向到指定 panel。结果模型会被迫去描述被指向的区域。关键点在于，这种干预有一个很窄的有效窗口：干预太少，控制力不够；干预太多，会破坏语言流畅性和整体生成，说明 gaze heads 负责“看哪里”，但不是全部生成机制。文中还展示了 mid-generation intervention：生成到一半再切换目标区域，模型会先收尾当前 panel，再转去描述新 panel，说明这些头参与的是在线的视觉-语言路由，而不是一次性全局规划。
summary.experiments:
主实验基于 Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。模型是 36 层、每层 32 个头，共 1152 个 attention heads。发现阶段使用 COMICS 数据集中的 3948 个漫画样本，构造成六格横向拼接 strip；评估阶段使用 500 个由 GPT Image-1 生成、各 panel 视觉差异明确的六格漫画，避免 discovery data 泄漏。

几个关键结果值得记。第一，read-in-reverse direction 的层定位实验表明，只有第 20–28 层注入该方向时，模型才会显著从左到右答案翻转为从右到左答案，说明顺序表征高度局部化。第二，作者识别出 top-100 gaze heads，少于总头数的 9%。第三，只对这些 gaze heads 做 attention 重定向，就能以 83.1% 的准确率把 VQA 答案引导到指定 panel，而随机非 gaze heads 的同类干预接近失败；文中给出的 chance 是 16.7%，对应六选一。第四，控制效果不是单调增加的：头数太少只能部分转向，头数太多会损伤生成，说明这些头是一个功能子回路，而不是越多越好。第五，这套发现不仅在漫画上成立，也能迁移到自然图像和其他 VLM 尺寸/架构上，支持其普遍性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction 和 Experimental Setup，理解为什么作者选 comic strips 而不是自然图像：不是为了做漫画任务，而是为了把“叙述顺序”变成可观测、可验证的空间结构。然后重点看 Sec. 4/5 附近关于 read-in-reverse direction 和 gaze head discovery 的方法，以及对应图 1 和 head 分布图。最后看 redirection intervention 的结果图表，这部分最能说明相关性是否上升为因果性。

如果只打算花 25–35 分钟，建议顺序是：层定位实验 → gaze head 打分方法 → top-100 干预结果 → 泛化到自然图像/其他模型。值得深挖的点有三个：一是这些 gaze heads 是否来自预训练阶段还是 instruction tuning 阶段形成；二是它们与已有 image heads / localization heads 的重叠程度；三是这种稀疏可控子回路能否反过来用于多模态训练时的 regularization、对齐诊断或 hallucination 抑制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific internal question in VLMs: when a model describes an image, which part of the network tracks the visual region currently being verbalized, and does that mechanism actually control what gets described? Rather than identifying generic “image-attending heads,” the authors look for a temporally aligned subset of attention heads whose focus moves with the generated narration. They call these heads gaze heads and test whether they are merely correlated with grounding or causally sufficient to steer it.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining-method paper. It is closer to mechanistic interpretability for VLMs. Still, it has useful implications for multimodal pretraining. It suggests that visual grounding inside a language-model backbone may be concentrated in a relatively small mid-to-late-layer subcircuit rather than spread uniformly across the network. That matters for architecture design, adapter placement, sparse intervention, and possibly distillation. It also reinforces a broader point: image-text alignment is not only an encoder-side representation issue. There is an online routing mechanism inside the decoder/backbone that decides which visual tokens are being turned into language at each step.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three parts. First, the authors localize where “reading order” lives in the network. They use six-panel comic strips as a controlled environment because spatial layout naturally encodes narrative order. For the same strip, they compare a normal prompt with a prompt that asks the model to read the comic in reverse. From the residual stream before the answer, they compute a difference-of-means direction for each layer. They then inject that direction into a fresh forward pass and measure whether the answer flips from left-to-right reading to right-to-left reading. Only a narrow band of layers, roughly 20 to 28, produces the flip, indicating that ordering behavior is localized in mid-late layers.

Second, within that band they identify gaze heads using a simple correlation score. A head qualifies if its attention consistently lands on the panel currently being described and shifts as the narration moves forward. In Qwen3-VL-8B, about 100 out of 1,152 heads satisfy this pattern, or 8.7% of all heads. These heads cluster in the same mid-late region. The same discovery procedure recovers similar head sets across model sizes from 2B to 32B and across other VLM architectures, which argues against this being an artifact of one checkpoint.

Third, they perform causal interventions by directly modifying the attention masks of those heads at inference time. Redirecting the gaze heads to a chosen panel causes the model to describe that panel instead. The intervention is sharply tuned: too few redirected heads give only partial control, while too many break fluent generation by overriding heads needed for language modeling. They also show mid-generation steering, where the model finishes the current panel and then switches to the newly targeted one, suggesting that these heads participate in an online grounding mechanism rather than a one-shot global plan.
summary_en.experiments:
The main model is Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, with a 36-layer language backbone and 32 attention heads per layer, for 1,152 heads total. Discovery uses 3,948 comic samples from COMICS, converted into six-panel horizontal strips. Evaluation uses a disjoint set of 500 six-panel strips generated with GPT Image-1, where each panel is visually distinct enough to make grounding unambiguous.

Several results stand out. First, the reverse-reading direction only works when injected into layers 20–28, showing strong localization of reading-order control. Second, the authors identify a top-100 set of gaze heads, fewer than 9% of all heads. Third, redirecting only these heads steers the VQA answer to a chosen panel with 83.1% accuracy, versus a 16.7% chance level for six panels; comparable interventions on random non-gaze heads fail to redirect reliably. Fourth, the control effect is not monotonic: too little intervention is weak, too much damages generation quality. That supports the view that gaze heads form a functional subcircuit rather than a generic attention mass. Finally, the phenomenon transfers beyond comics to natural images and appears across multiple VLM sizes and architectures.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the introduction and setup to understand why comics are used. The point is not comic understanding as a task, but a controlled spatial proxy for narration order. Then read the section on the reverse-reading direction and the layer-localization result, especially Figure 1. After that, focus on the gaze-head discovery criterion and the intervention results. Those are the parts that establish both localization and causality.

A 25–35 minute pass is enough. Read in this order: layer localization, gaze-head scoring, top-100 redirection experiments, then the transfer results to natural images and other models. The most interesting follow-up questions are whether these heads emerge during multimodal pretraining or later instruction tuning, how much they overlap with previously reported image/localization heads, and whether this sparse subcircuit can be used for training-time diagnostics, regularization, or hallucination control.

recommendation.zh: David Bau 组发现 VLM 中存在专门追踪图像区域的 gaze heads——对理解多模态预训练中的注意力分工有启发，看实验章节即可。
recommendation.en: David Bau's group discovers dedicated gaze heads in VLMs — informative for understanding attention specialization in multimodal pretraining; read experiments only.

paper.title: Reasoning as Pattern Matching: Shared Mechanisms in Human and LLM Everyday Reasoning
paper.abstract: When large language models (LLMs) fail to generalize or make haphazard errors in reasoning, it is often taken as evidence that LLMs are not truly reasoning, but rather performing a kind of pattern matching. The implication is that people's behavior does not exhibit the same types of failures because human reasoning uses principled and abstract world models. We evaluate human participants and 25 LLMs on their ability to engage in common-sense reasoning about a variety of everyday situations and o

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的是：LLM 在日常常识推理中的错误，究竟只是“模式匹配”失灵，还是反映了更抽象的世界模型推理；同时，人类在类似任务上是否真的遵循不同机制。
summary.importance: 它属于机制分析与认知对照研究。价值不在于提出新模型，而在于给出一个不太讨喜但值得认真看的判断：人类和 LLM 在 everyday reasoning 上可能共享更接近模式匹配的机制，而不是人类显著更依赖抽象世界模型。这会影响我们如何解释 CoT、generalization failure 和 attention-level circuitry。
summary.technical_approach: 作者同时测试人类参与者和 25 个 LLM 在一组日常情境常识推理任务上的表现，比较错误模式是否一致；随后定位驱动模型回答的注意力头，并将这些头解释为执行某种 pattern-matching 的机制，再用这些头去预测由看似无关提示细节引发的人类错误。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的是行为模式与机制定位结果，而非大规模训练实验。实验覆盖 25 个 LLM 和人类被试，核心发现是两者出现相似的错误分布；并且一组特定 attention heads 能解释模型输出，也能预测人类受无关 prompt 细节干扰时的错误。若正文做得扎实，这类“人-模同构错误 + 头级机制锚定”的证据比一般行为学对比更有分量。
summary.authors_note: 作者为 Zach Studdiford、Gary Lupyan。Gary Lupyan 以语言、认知与概念表征研究见长，这使论文更像认知科学与机制解释的交叉工作，而不是常规 LLM benchmark 论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether everyday reasoning errors in LLMs are merely failures of pattern matching or evidence against genuine reasoning, and whether humans actually rely on a different mechanism in similar tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic and cognitive-comparison paper. Its value is not in proposing a new model, but in making an uncomfortable claim worth checking carefully: human and LLM everyday reasoning may share a pattern-matching-like mechanism rather than humans relying much more on abstract world models. That matters for how we interpret CoT, generalization failures, and attention-level circuits.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate human participants and 25 LLMs on common-sense reasoning over everyday situations, compare their error patterns, then identify attention heads that drive model responses and interpret them as implementing a form of pattern matching. They further use these heads to predict human errors triggered by seemingly irrelevant prompt details.
summary_en.experiments: The contribution is behavioral and mechanistic rather than a large-scale training result. The study covers 25 LLMs plus human participants, with the main finding that both show similar error patterns; moreover, a specific set of attention heads explains model outputs and predicts human mistakes induced by irrelevant prompt details. If the full paper is careful, this combination of human-model error alignment and head-level anchoring is stronger than a typical behavioral comparison.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper is by Zach Studdiford and Gary Lupyan. Gary Lupyan is known for work on language, cognition, and conceptual representation, which makes this more of a cognitive-science-meets-mechanistic-interpretability paper than a standard LLM benchmark paper.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会动摇“人类靠抽象规则、LLM 只是 pattern matching”的舒服叙事；先看 attention-head 证据链是否站得住，再决定要不要更新你对日常推理机制的 prior。
recommendation.en: This challenges the comforting story that humans use abstract rules while LLMs merely pattern-match; check whether the attention-head evidence really closes that loop before updating your prior.

paper.title: A retrieval conditioned rebinding circuit for dynamic entity tracking in large language models
paper.abstract: To interpret context correctly and retrieve relevant information, large language models must bind entities to their attributes and update these bindings as state changes. We analyze how LLMs implement this binding process in a dynamic state tracking. Using causal interventions, we identify a retrieval conditioned rebinding mechanism, a compact attention head circuit that encodes swap relevant binding information and reinstates it at readout. Across Gemma and Llama models, this circuit supports r

summary.core_problem: 解释 LLM 在动态状态跟踪中如何把实体与属性绑定，并在上下文变化后完成重新绑定。
summary.importance: 这类工作对基座研究员的价值在于把“entity tracking”从行为现象落到可干预的电路层机制，能帮助理解 attention head 在上下文更新中的功能分工，也可能反哺架构与训练诊断。
summary.technical_approach: 作者用因果干预分析，在 Gemma 和 Llama 中定位到一个 retrieval-conditioned rebinding circuit：一组紧凑的注意力头先编码与交换相关的绑定信息，再在读出阶段恢复。进一步比较不同模型家族的表征位置，发现 Gemma 主要在 query/key 子空间显式表达绑定特征，而 Llama 更依赖 key 向量承载该信息。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Gemma 和 Llama 两个模型家族，核心证据来自因果干预而非纯相关性分析。摘要未给出具体层数、头数和任务集，但明确声称该电路在两类模型中都支持 rebinding，只是表示形式不同。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper investigates how LLMs bind entities to attributes and then rebind them when context changes during dynamic state tracking.
summary_en.importance: For foundation-model researchers, the value is that it grounds entity tracking in an intervention-tested circuit-level mechanism. That helps clarify the functional roles of attention heads in context updates and may inform architecture or training diagnostics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using causal interventions, the authors identify a retrieval-conditioned rebinding circuit in Gemma and Llama: a compact set of attention heads encodes swap-relevant binding information and reinstates it at readout. They further compare representational loci across model families, finding that Gemma expresses the binding signature in query/key subspaces, while Llama carries it mainly in key vectors.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span Gemma and Llama families, with evidence based on causal intervention rather than correlation alone. The abstract does not specify exact layers, heads, or task sets, but it claims the circuit supports rebinding in both families with different representational signatures.

recommendation.zh: 不是会立刻改训练 recipe 的论文，但若你关心 state tracking 的电路实现，这篇比泛泛 attention 可视化干净得多，重点看因果干预部分。
recommendation.en: Not a recipe-changing paper, but if you care about state tracking circuits, this is much cleaner than generic attention visualization—read the intervention section.

paper.title: Ablation-Reversible Heads Don't Transfer: A Stress Test for Mechanistic Role Claims in Transformers
paper.abstract: In mechanistic interpretability, attention heads are commonly elevated to role claims (e.g., "this head represents addition") when they are necessary for a behavior, encode it linearly, and recover that behavior when restored after ablation. We show this evidence is insufficient: across three 7-8B instruction-tuned models and five computation families, heads passing all three checks routinely fail to transfer the computation when their activations are patched into a different prompt under matche

summary.core_problem: 机制可解释性领域广泛使用的三项注意力头功能判定标准（必要性、线性编码、ablation后恢复可还原行为）不足以证明头对应稳定的功能角色。
summary.importance: 原理分析，推翻了领域常用的注意力头角色赋值判据，提出了更严格的功能验证方法与初步的头角色分类体系。
summary.technical_approach: 提出KID（认知/意图/执行）角色分析视角，搭配三阶段验证管道：能力选择性筛选、奇异值分解、匹配控制下的激活移植测试，验证注意力头功能的跨prompt可迁移性。
summary.experiments: 在3个7-8B参数的指令微调模型、5类计算任务上测试，发现通过原有三项检查的注意力头大多无法在跨prompt的激活移植中传递对应功能，提出了包含prompt轨迹稳定器、答案侧logit偏置头在内的角色分类。

summary_en.core_problem: Three commonly used criteria for assigning functional roles to attention heads (necessity for behavior, linear encoding, performance recovery after ablation) are insufficient to prove stable functional roles.
summary_en.importance: Principle analysis, overturns the widely adopted criteria for attention head role assignment, and proposes a stricter verification method and preliminary role taxonomy.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the KID (Knowing / Intent / Doing) analysis lens, paired with a three-stage pipeline: capability-selective screening, singular value decomposition, and activation transduction under matched controls to test cross-prompt transferability of head functions.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 3 7-8B instruction-tuned models across 5 computation families, finding that most heads passing all three original criteria fail to transfer computation when patched to different prompts; a taxonomy including prompt-trajectory stabilizers and logit-bias heads is proposed.

recommendation.zh: 推翻了注意力头功能赋值的常用判据，做Transformer机制分析或架构迭代的必须看§3的实验设计。
recommendation.en: Overturns common criteria for attention head functional role assignment; anyone doing Transformer mechanistic analysis or architecture iteration must read §3 experimental design.

paper.title: Closure-Validated Circuit Discovery in Attention Heads: Co-activation Proposes, Ablation Disposes
paper.abstract: Interpretability increasingly treats groups of components, not individual units, as the basic object, and proposes to find them by clustering co-activation statistics. We ask whether such a cheap signal actually identifies an attention-head circuit. Adapting a sparse-autoencoder clustering recipe to attention heads -- but validating by causal ablation rather than reconstruction -- we cluster heads and then run a closure test: ablate the discovered community and compare per-example damage to matc

summary.core_problem: 解决“基于共激活聚类发现的 attention head 社区，是否真的对应可因果验证的功能电路”这个可解释性问题。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，价值在于给廉价电路发现信号加上因果 closure 检验，并指出在 MoE 和训练过程中，表面上的结构信号可能与真实功能脱钩。对做训练动态、路由分析、可解释性评估的人有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把稀疏自编码器启发的聚类配方迁移到 attention heads：先按共激活统计聚类，再用因果消融做 closure test，比较消融整个社区与匹配随机对照在逐样本损失上的差异。进一步在 OLMoE 上做 route-conditional clustering，并沿训练过程跟踪 attention-target selectivity 与 participation ratio，检查这些代理指标是否真能反映功能。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个 1B 级稠密模型 Pythia-1B、OLMo-1B，以及一个 MoE 模型 OLMoE-1B-7B，并在两种输入分布上测试。结果是：稠密模型中的社区能通过 closure；MoE 中 route-conditional clustering 虽有统计信号，但不通过 closure，甚至消融后 loss 改善；跨训练阶段看，attention-target selectivity 和 participation ratio 都会与真实功能双向脱钩。这里的贡献不是刷指标，而是给出负结果和更干净的验证框架。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether attention-head communities discovered from co-activation statistics actually correspond to causally valid functional circuits.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism/interpretability paper with a useful methodological point: cheap circuit-discovery signals need causal closure tests. The negative results in MoE and across training are relevant if you analyze routing, training dynamics, or interpretability proxies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper adapts a sparse-autoencoder-inspired clustering recipe to attention heads: cluster heads by co-activation, then validate with a closure test based on causal ablation, comparing per-example damage against matched-random controls. It further studies route-conditional clustering in OLMoE and tracks attention-target selectivity plus participation ratio over training.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses two dense 1B models, Pythia-1B and OLMo-1B, plus the MoE model OLMoE-1B-7B, across two input distributions. Dense-model communities pass closure. In the MoE model, route-conditional clustering yields a statistically real signal that fails closure, with ablation improving loss. Across training, attention-target selectivity and participation ratio decouple from function in both directions. The contribution is less about benchmark wins and more about a cleaner validation protocol and informative negative results.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改训练 recipe，但会改你看 interpretability proxy 的口径：先看 closure test 设计和 MoE 负结果，很多漂亮聚类图到这里就站不住了。
recommendation.en: It will not change your training recipe, but it should change how seriously you take interpretability proxies; read the closure test and the MoE negative result first.

paper.title: Mechanistic Insights into Functional Sparsity in Multimodal LLMs via CoRe Heads
paper.abstract: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate remarkable proficiency on complex vision-language tasks, the mechanisms by which they extract query-relevant visual features from complex, noisy contexts remain opaque. In this paper, we present an in-depth interpretability study that uncovers a profound structural property within MLLMs: functional sparsity in cross-modal retrieval. Leveraging a token-level metric termed Retrieval Attention Mass (RAM), we identify and characterize a high

summary.core_problem: 多模态 LLM 在复杂视觉上下文里如何“从噪声中检索出与问题相关的视觉 token”，以及这种跨模态检索是否由少量结构化组件承担。论文试图用可量化指标把“哪些注意力头在做真正的检索”从经验观察变成可复现的测量与因果验证。
summary.importance:
这是一篇机制可解释性工作，不是预训练方法论文。对预训练研究的启发主要在两点：
1）它给了一个可操作的 head-level 度量（RAM）和跨数据集的一致性观察，能帮助诊断 MLLM 在对齐/长上下文/噪声视觉输入下的失败模式。
2）它暗示跨模态检索存在功能稀疏性（少量关键 heads 非冗余），这对后续的结构化剪枝、稀疏注意力、以及“训练时是否应该显式鼓励检索头形成”这类预训练目标设计有间接参考价值。
但它没有提出新的预训练 recipe，也没有证明通过训练改动能产生这些 CoRe heads 或提升泛化。
summary.technical_approach:
核心方法是定义并用标注区域监督来“定位检索头”。
- RAM（Retrieval Attention Mass）：对每个 head，取 query tokens 指向 ground-truth 关键视觉 token 区域 Ω(V*) 的注意力权重总和/均值，作为该 head 的检索强度分数。关键点是只统计 query→vision 的子矩阵，避免把 text-text 或 vision-vision 的注意力混进来。
- CoRe heads：按 RAM 排序后，发现一小部分 heads 在多数据集、多模型上稳定高 RAM，被解释为 Context-aware Retrieval heads（专门做 query-conditioned 的视觉信息抽取）。其余 heads 更像做全局聚合或背景分配。
- 因果验证：通过 attention masking/ablation 只屏蔽 top 比例的 CoRe heads，观察下游任务性能下降，用来证明这些 heads 不是“可有可无的注意力集中”，而是功能必需。
- 规模与层分布：随模型变大，CoRe heads 更集中在中后层；同时存在“全局一致的约 30 个头”与“随数据分布变化的局部可变头”。
summary.experiments:
覆盖多种视觉域与任务：视频时空指代/定位（VidSTG）、文档理解检索（MMDocIR）、指代表达视觉定位（RefCOCOg）、长上下文多模态推理（MMLongBench）；模型包括 LLaVA-OneVision、InternVL3.5、Qwen3-VL 系列不同规模。
关键结果是三类：
1）RAM 能稳定分离出少量高分 heads，并在可视化上呈现更精确的目标区域对齐；低分 heads 更弥散。
2）消融 top 5% CoRe heads 会带来显著性能下降（文中强调“significant drop”，但在给定内容片段里未出现具体数值）。
3）层分布随 scale 向中后层迁移，以及“约 30 个头”跨设置稳定出现。
如果要评估其对训练的意义，需要进一步核对：RAM 依赖的 ground-truth 区域标注质量、不同 tokenizer/patching 下 Ω(V*) 的定义是否稳健、以及 ablation 是否控制了总注意力质量（例如是否引入分布漂移）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–40 分钟）：
- RAM 定义与实现细节：看它如何划分 query tokens、视觉 token span Ω(V*)，以及为什么只看 query→vision 子矩阵。
- CoRe heads 的一致性结论：重点看跨模型/跨数据集的 head 排名稳定性与“约 30 个头”的证据。
- 因果消融：看 attention masking 的具体做法（mask 在 softmax 前后、是否重归一化）、以及性能下降对应哪些任务最敏感。
对预训练研究者，值得额外做的延伸阅读是：这些 CoRe heads 是否在不同训练阶段出现（若文中有训练动态分析），以及它们与对齐损失/视觉编码器接口的关系。

summary_en.core_problem: Understanding how multimodal LLMs retrieve query-relevant visual evidence from cluttered visual contexts, and whether this cross-modal retrieval is carried by a small, structured subset of attention heads rather than being diffusely distributed across the network.
summary_en.importance: Primarily a mechanistic interpretability paper, not a pretraining-method contribution. Its value to foundation-model training is indirect: (1) it introduces an operational head-level metric (RAM) that can be used to diagnose grounding/retrieval behavior and failure modes under noisy or long-context multimodal inputs; (2) it provides evidence for functional sparsity—few non-redundant cross-modal retrieval heads—which can inform structured pruning, sparse attention designs, or future training objectives that explicitly encourage robust retrieval circuits. It does not, however, propose or validate a modified pretraining recipe that improves these properties.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper isolates “retrieval heads” using a supervised attention-mass metric.
- Retrieval Attention Mass (RAM): for each head, compute the attention mass from query tokens to the ground-truth visual token span Ω(V*) (object regions / temporal segments), focusing specifically on the query→vision attention sub-matrix to avoid intra-modal confounds.
- CoRe heads: heads with consistently high RAM are labeled Context-aware Retrieval heads, interpreted as dedicated query-conditioned visual extractors; most other heads exhibit broader, more diffuse attention patterns.
- Causal testing: ablate/mask only the top fraction of CoRe heads and measure downstream performance drops to argue necessity rather than correlation.
- Scaling/layer localization: as models scale, CoRe heads concentrate more in mid-to-late layers; the authors also claim a mix of globally consistent heads (~30) and dataset-adaptive ones.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated across diverse multimodal datasets: VidSTG (video spatiotemporal grounding), MMDocIR (document/layout retrieval), RefCOCOg (referring expression grounding), and MMLongBench (long-context multimodal reasoning). Models include LLaVA-OneVision, InternVL3.5, and Qwen3-VL at multiple scales.
Main empirical claims: (1) RAM cleanly separates a small set of heads whose attention visualizations tightly localize relevant entities; low-RAM heads attend diffusely to background. (2) Masking the top 5% CoRe heads yields a significant performance drop (the provided excerpt does not include exact numbers). (3) CoRe head locations shift toward later layers with scale, and ~30 heads appear consistently across settings.
For training-oriented interpretation, the key robustness questions are how Ω(V*) is defined under different visual tokenizations, sensitivity to annotation noise, and whether the ablation protocol preserves attention normalization to avoid introducing unrelated distribution shifts.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–40 minutes):
- Read the RAM definition carefully: how query tokens and Ω(V*) are constructed, and why only query→vision attention is used.
- Check the cross-model/dataset stability evidence for CoRe heads (including the “~30 universal heads” claim).
- Inspect the causal ablation protocol: where masking is applied (pre/post-softmax), whether renormalization is done, and which tasks degrade most.
If you are thinking about pretraining implications, look for any training-dynamics analysis (when these heads emerge) and how they relate to the vision-tokenizer / projector interface and alignment losses.

recommendation.zh: 这类头级功能稀疏结论未必能直接迁移到训练 recipe，但若你在想多模态路由/剪枝，先看 RAM 定义和 5% 消融结果。
recommendation.en: The head-level sparsity story may not transfer cleanly into training recipes, but if you care about multimodal routing or pruning, read the RAM definition and the 5% ablation result.

paper.title: Multi-component Causal Tracing in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Causal tracing systematically intervenes on a large language model's (LLM's) internal representations to uncover and quantify the causal pathways linking specific inputs or computations to specific metrics of interest, quantifying the LLM's behavior. Building on previous single-component or single-layer studies, this paper presents a unified framework for causally tracing multiple components simultaneously. This framework systematically identifies the subsets of components (e.g., attention heads

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：现有 causal tracing 大多一次只分析单个组件，或者把多组件影响近似成线性可加，但真实的 LLM 电路里常常存在非线性交互，单组件分析会错过真正起作用的组合。作者因此把问题重新表述为一个组合优化任务：在给定干预方式和目标指标后，从大量 attention heads / MLP neurons 中找出一个子集，使联合干预后的目标指标最大，同时控制子集稀疏度。
summary.importance: 它对预训练的直接作用不是提出新 recipe，而是提供一种更强的训练后诊断工具。对基座研究员而言，价值在两点。第一，它提醒人们不要把模型内部因果贡献默认看成可加的；如果多组件交互普遍存在，那么很多基于单层、单头、单神经元的重要性结论都可能不稳。第二，它给出了一个可扩展的搜索框架，能把 tracing 从“画热力图”推进到“找最关键的联合子电路”，这对理解 fine-tuning 改了什么、偏见或事实性由哪些组件共同承载、以及后续做 targeted editing / sparse intervention 都有帮助。
summary.technical_approach:
论文先统一定义了 multi-component causal tracing。模型内部有一组可干预组件，可以是 attention heads、MLP neurons 或其他模块；用户还要指定一个 metric，可以是准确率、公平性、事实性等任意可计算目标。问题变成：在所有组件子集上搜索，找到联合干预后最优的那一组。难点显然是组合爆炸。

作者的解法是把离散子集选择松弛成连续优化。具体做法是对每个候选组件引入一个软门控变量，通过 soft intervention 控制该组件是否被 patch / restore / replace。这样，原本不可导的子集搜索被转成可用梯度下降优化的连续问题。

但仅有软门控还不够，因为目标 metric 往往是离散或不适合直接优化的。论文因此加入 metric transformation，把原始评价量变成更适合梯度优化的形式。摘要和引言没有展开全部公式，但从作者描述看，这一步是为了改善梯度信号，使优化不至于被稀疏、离散、饱和的指标卡住。

另一个关键设计是 scheduled penalty function。作者不是简单加一个固定 L1 或 hard top-k 约束，而是设计了随训练过程变化的惩罚项，让门控值逐步向稀疏和二值化收缩，并在达到目标 sparsity 时停止。这个设计同时服务两个目标：一是避免一开始就把搜索空间压得太死，二是最终得到可解释的离散组件子集，而不是一堆模糊权重。

论文还把自己的方法和 top-k、greedy、以及已有 gradient-based tracing 方法做比较，并指出某些已有方法的效果差异很大程度来自 penalty 和优化细节，而不是“梯度法天然更强或更弱”。这点很重要，因为它把问题从算法标签之争，拉回到具体优化设计。

从方法定位看，这不是 mechanistic interpretability 里那种手工电路分析，而是一个更通用的 tracing optimizer：给定可干预组件、干预算子和目标 metric，就能自动搜索关键联合子集。
summary.experiments:
实验部分的主线有两层。第一层是现象验证：作者在 GPT2-small 和两个数据集上展示，某些 attention head 或 MLP neuron 的成对联合干预，会产生明显偏离单独干预求和的效果，也就是存在显著非线性 interaction。文中用一个 pairwise heatmap 展示 joint intervention metric 减去 individual metrics 之和，红蓝区域都很明显，这直接反驳了“组件贡献大致线性可加”的默认假设至少并不普适。

第二层是算法比较。作者将提出的连续优化方法与 top-k、greedy 等基线比较，结论是基线在效率和效果上都不稳定，而所提方法能在更大的组合空间里更有效地找到高价值组件子集。摘要截断处没有给出完整数字，但正文明确声称 baseline top-k 和 greedy 在若干设置下会明显落后；同时，作者还分析了 Davies et al. (2023) 一类 gradient-based 搜索方法，认为其性能差距很大程度上由 penalty 与 optimization choices 驱动，并在附录中做了更细的对照。

从研究者视角，更值得看的不是单个绝对分数，而是三类实验设计：一，是否在不同 metric 上都能工作，而不只针对 accuracy；二，是否同时支持不同组件粒度，如 head 和 neuron；三，搜索出的子集是否真的更稀疏且更有解释性，而不是靠大面积干预换来指标提升。论文的卖点正是这三点的统一。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议先看 Introduction 里 Figure 1 及其解释。那张图基本说明了整篇工作的动机：多组件联合效应并不总是线性。

然后看问题定义和优化目标。重点不是记公式，而是弄清三件事：组件集合怎么参数化，intervention 怎么做，metric 为什么需要 transformation。若这三点看懂，后面的算法细节就容易跟上。

再看 penalty scheduling 的设计。这里是方法成败的关键，因为它决定了连续松弛最后能不能收敛到有意义的稀疏离散解。阅读时可以顺手对照作者对 Davies et al. 的批评，看看差异究竟落在目标函数、正则项还是优化流程上。

最后看实验里 pairwise interaction 的可视化和与 top-k / greedy 的比较。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主线。若只想知道这篇论文有没有方法含量，就看 unified framework、soft intervention、metric transformation、scheduled penalty 这四处。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of standard causal tracing: most prior work studies one component at a time, or implicitly assumes that multi-component effects are roughly additive. The authors argue that this misses genuinely important interactions inside LLMs. They therefore formulate multi-component causal tracing as a combinatorial search problem: given a set of intervenable components and a target metric, find the subset whose joint intervention maximizes that metric under a sparsity constraint.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining recipe, but it is relevant as a stronger diagnostic tool for foundation-model research. Two points matter. First, it challenges the common habit of interpreting component importance as if it were additive. If nonlinear interactions are common, conclusions drawn from single-head or single-neuron tracing can be incomplete or misleading. Second, it turns causal tracing into a practical search problem over joint circuits rather than a collection of isolated heatmaps. That is useful for studying what fine-tuning changes, where bias or factual behavior is jointly encoded, and how to design more targeted editing or intervention methods.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper defines a general framework for multi-component causal tracing. A model contains a set of candidate components, such as attention heads or MLP neurons. The user also specifies an intervention operator and a metric of interest, which can be accuracy, fairness, factuality, or another task-specific quantity. The objective is to find the subset of components whose joint intervention optimizes the chosen metric.

The main challenge is combinatorial explosion. The proposed solution is to relax discrete subset selection into a continuous optimization problem. Each candidate component receives a soft gating variable controlling whether and how strongly that component is intervened on. This turns subset search into a differentiable optimization problem amenable to gradient descent.

A second issue is that the target metric is often discrete, sparse, or otherwise poorly behaved for direct optimization. The method therefore introduces a metric transformation that produces a smoother optimization signal. The exact form depends on the setup, but the role is clear: make gradient-based search viable for metrics that would otherwise provide weak or unstable gradients.

The third key ingredient is a scheduled penalty function. Instead of using a fixed sparsity penalty or a hard top-k rule from the start, the method gradually increases pressure toward sparse and binary gates. This allows the search to explore early and then converge to an interpretable discrete subset later. The schedule is also designed to stop once the desired sparsity level is reached.

The paper positions this as a general tracing optimizer rather than a hand-built mechanistic analysis. Given components, interventions, and a metric, it can search for jointly important subsets across different tasks and component granularities.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical story has two parts. First, the paper demonstrates the phenomenon it is built around: nonlinear interactions between components. On GPT2-small and two datasets, the authors show that intervening on certain pairs of attention heads or MLP neurons produces effects that differ substantially from the sum of the two single-component interventions. They visualize this with pairwise interaction heatmaps, where the joint metric minus the sum of individual metrics shows strong positive and negative regions. This is the central evidence against a blanket linearity assumption.

Second, the paper compares its optimization-based search against simpler baselines such as top-k and greedy selection, and also discusses prior gradient-based tracing methods. The claim is that naive baselines are both less effective and less efficient in the combinatorial setting, while the proposed method finds better sparse subsets more reliably. The introduction and abstract do not expose all numerical details, but the full text emphasizes that optimization choices, especially the penalty design and schedule, explain much of the gap between methods.

From a research perspective, the most important experimental questions are whether the framework works across different metrics rather than only accuracy, whether it supports multiple component types such as heads and neurons, and whether the selected subsets remain sparse and interpretable rather than relying on broad interventions. Those are the dimensions to watch while reading the results.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with Figure 1 and the surrounding discussion in the introduction. That figure carries the main motivation: joint effects between components are not reliably additive.

Then read the formal problem setup and the optimization objective. The key is not memorizing the equations, but understanding three design choices: how components are parameterized, how interventions are applied, and why the metric needs to be transformed before optimization.

Next, focus on the scheduled penalty mechanism. This is likely the most important technical detail, because the success of the continuous relaxation depends on whether it can end in a sparse, near-binary, interpretable solution. It is also the right place to compare the method against prior gradient-based tracing approaches.

Finally, inspect the pairwise interaction visualizations and the comparisons with top-k and greedy baselines. A 25–35 minute skim should be enough to capture the main contribution. If time is short, prioritize the unified framework, soft interventions, metric transformation, and penalty scheduling.

recommendation.zh: 不是会改写 pretrain prior 的论文，但若你在做 activation patching/causal mediation，这篇把“多组件联合归因”做成可优化问题，方法层面值得借来做训练诊断。
recommendation.en: Not a prior-shifting pretrain paper, but if you use activation patching or causal mediation, this is worth reading for turning joint component attribution into an optimization problem for training diagnostics.

paper.title: Revealing Algorithmic Deductive Circuits for Logical Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent studies have shown that Large Language Models (LLMs) can achieve strong reasoning performance by incorporating functional symbolic representations that abstractly describe graph traversal algorithms and step-by-step reasoning in few-shot learning settings. However, it remains unclear how LLMs genuinely understand the abstract meaning of each reasoning step and the overall algorithm from only a limited number of demonstrations. This work aims to localize the attention heads responsible for

summary.core_problem: 在符号辅助 CoT 的演绎推理任务中，LLM 是如何在内部实现“按算法执行”的：哪些注意力头负责单步推理的关键决策（选前提、停止选前提、选规则），这些头之间传递什么信息，以及它们对最终推理路径的因果作用有多大。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，而是机制分析/可解释性工作。对预训练研究的间接价值在于：它把“推理步骤的关键 token 位点”与“可定位的注意力头电路”对应起来，提供了一种更细粒度的诊断框架，可用于评估不同预训练/中期训练配方是否真的改变了推理电路（而不只是改变表面输出）。此外，它强调了少数“高不确定 token”对推理轨迹的支配作用，这对构造更有效的训练信号（例如在这些位点做 targeted loss / curriculum / verifier shaping）有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在 Symbolic-Aided CoT 框架下，把演绎推理形式化为推理图上的遍历过程（示例提到 BFS/DFS 的演示会诱导不同的遍历偏好）。先做一个定位步骤：把 CoT 中的组成步骤与对应的 token logits 对齐，找出跨模型家族都“难解码”的不确定 token（通常是决定推理分支的起始 token，例如选择哪个前提字母、是否停止选前提、选择哪条规则）。然后用因果中介分析（CMA）与 activation/path patching 去找“对这些不确定 token 的 logit 变化有因果贡献”的注意力头子集，并进一步恢复这些头之间的信息流图，形成一个由多个子电路组成的 circuit network（分别对应 premise selection / termination / rule selection）。最后通过 knock-out（移除/抑制这些头）在标准演绎推理基准上验证电路的可迁移性与必要性。
summary.experiments:
实验主线包括三部分：
1) 统计性预实验：在合成数据上识别不确定 token 位点，并观察其在不同模型/规模上普遍存在。
2) 电路抽取：构造“干净 vs 污染”的提示对（针对每个推理组件分别污染），用 activation patching/path patching 找关键注意力头与信息流。
3) 因果验证：对抽取出的头做 knock-out，并在 ProntoQA 等演绎推理基准上评估性能下降，以证明这些头对推理步骤执行是必要的。
当前提供的全文片段未包含具体模型列表、层/头数量、以及 knock-out 后的定量跌幅表格，因此无法可靠给出数值级结论；精读需要直接看实验章节的电路可视化图与性能表。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
- 先看他们如何定义并自动对齐“推理组件 ↔ token 位点”，以及“不确定 token”的判据（这决定了后续 CMA 的目标是否合理）。
- 重点看数据构造：clean/corrupted prompt 的污染方式是否只改变一个组件、是否引入分布外噪声。
- 看 circuit network 的信息流图：哪些层的头在读 KB snapshot、哪些在实现遍历偏好（BFS/DFS），哪些在把已证明事实写回。
- 最后看 knock-out 的泛化验证：是否跨任务/跨提示模板仍然成立，还是只对合成格式有效。

summary_en.core_problem: In symbolic-aided CoT deductive reasoning, what internal mechanisms enable an LLM to execute an algorithm-like multi-step procedure: which attention heads causally implement key step decisions (premise selection, termination, rule selection), what information they carry, and how they interact as a circuit network.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper; it is mechanistic interpretability. The indirect relevance to pretraining is diagnostic: it links a small set of trajectory-steering ‘uncertain tokens’ to identifiable attention-head circuits, offering a way to test whether changes in pretraining/mid-training actually modify reasoning circuitry rather than just surface-form outputs. The emphasis on a few high-leverage token positions also suggests targeted training signals (loss reweighting, curricula, verifier shaping) that focus on branch-defining decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under Symbolic-Aided CoT, the reasoning process is formalized as inference-graph traversal, with demonstrations potentially inducing traversal strategies (e.g., BFS vs DFS preferences). The pipeline is: (1) align constituent reasoning steps to token-level logits and identify ‘uncertain tokens’ that consistently steer the reasoning path (e.g., the first token choosing a premise label, the token deciding whether to stop selecting premises, the token choosing a rule); (2) apply causal mediation analysis with activation patching and path patching to find the subset of attention heads that causally drive logit changes at those uncertain tokens; (3) reconstruct information-flow graphs among these heads, yielding a circuit network with subcircuits per reasoning component; (4) validate necessity/generalization by knocking out the identified heads and measuring degradation on established deductive reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.experiments: Three experimental blocks: (i) preliminary analyses on synthetic data to locate uncertain token positions and show they persist across model families/sizes; (ii) circuit extraction using paired clean vs corrupted prompts per reasoning component, enabling activation/path patching attribution; (iii) causal validation via head knock-outs evaluated on benchmarks such as ProntoQA. The provided excerpt does not include the full quantitative tables (models used, number of heads, exact performance drops), so numeric claims should be checked directly in the results section and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the step-to-token alignment method and the operational definition of ‘uncertain tokens’; this is the foundation for the entire causal analysis.
- Inspect how clean/corrupted prompt pairs are constructed and whether corruption isolates a single component without introducing distribution shift artifacts.
- Study the circuit-network visualizations: which layers/heads read the KB snapshot, which encode traversal preferences, and which propagate proven facts.
- Check knock-out generalization: does the circuit remain important across tasks and prompt templates, or only within the synthetic symbolic format?

recommendation.zh: 读 §因果中介和 head 类型即可；若定位稳定，会给 CoT circuit 分析一个较干净的拆分模板。
recommendation.en: Read the causal mediation and head-typing parts; if stable, this gives a clean template for dissecting CoT circuits.

paper.title: MechRL: Reinforcement Learning Agents Perform Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has identified small sets of attention heads that implement specific behaviours in transformer language models, but recovering these circuits typically requires a bespoke analytical pipeline for each new task. We recast circuit discovery as a reinforcement-learning problem. An agent operates over the 144 attention heads of GPT-2 small as a discrete action space; each action triggers a zero-ablation and a contrastive reward that subtracts the ablation's damage to gene

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：能否把 mechanistic interpretability 里高度依赖人工设计和单任务分析的 circuit discovery，改写成一个可学习、可迁移的强化学习问题。具体地说，作者希望训练一个策略，在冻结的 GPT-2 small 上通过逐步选择并消融 attention head，自动找出对某个行为最关键、但对一般语言建模损伤较小的头部子集。难点不在“做 ablation”，而在于如何定义一个足够稳定的奖励，让 agent 学到任务特异电路，而不是只学会破坏模型最脆弱的通用头。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更偏机制分析与自动化解释工具，因此放在 skim 是合适的。但它仍有两点启发。第一，它把 circuit discovery 从离线打分问题变成 sequential decision problem，说明解释工作也可以有可迁移策略，而不必每个任务重做一套 pipeline。第二，文中设计的 contrastive reward 很有意思：用目标任务损伤减去自然文本上的一般语言建模损伤，试图分离 task-specific heads 和 general-purpose heads。这个想法对训练信号设计有参考价值，尤其是在想从“有害但不专属”的因果因素里剥离出“真正任务相关”的因素时。若从 LLM 基座研究角度看，它更像是 mechanistic interpretability 的方法论文，而不是 pretrain recipe 论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者把 GPT-2 small 的 144 个 attention heads 视为离散动作空间。每一步动作就是选择一个 head，在 hook_z 位置把该 head 输出置零，观察该消融对任务指标和控制指标的影响。环境是一个标准 Gymnasium MDP，episode 最多 50 步，且同一 episode 内不能重复选择同一 head。训练任务只有两个：induction 和 IOI。每次 reset 时随机采样任务并重新生成 batch，避免策略记住固定 head 排名。奖励设计是全文最关键的部分。对目标任务，使用 ablation 前后 logit difference 的下降作为损伤；对控制任务，使用自然英文文本上的 cross-entropy 上升作为一般语言建模损伤；最终 reward 是两者的差。这样，若某个 head 对所有任务都重要，消融它会同时伤害目标任务和一般文本，净奖励不会太高；若某个 head 主要服务于当前任务，reward 才会显著为正。观测包括三部分：当前任务 one-hot、已尝试 head 的 mask、已尝试 head 的归一化 reward 向量。后两者让策略能在单个 episode 内根据已获得反馈调整后续搜索。策略网络是一个小型 actor-critic MLP，输入 290 维，经过两层 256 隐层，输出 144 维动作分布和价值头。训练用 PPO，8 个并行环境，共 2e5 环境步。作者还加了一个 best-of-K 决策包装：策略先采样 K 个候选动作，环境并行评估后选 reward 最高者执行。K=1 是普通 PPO，K=5 则相当于给策略加了轻量规划/重采样。泛化测试使用训练中未见过的 docstring completion 任务，检查策略是否学到了可迁移的结构先验，而不是只记住 induction/IOI 的局部模式。
summary.experiments: 实验核心结论是：一个在 induction 和 IOI 上训练的 PPO 策略，能够在训练任务上接近每个 episode 的 oracle 选头表现，并在未见过的 docstring completion 上也有不错的迁移。摘要提到其偏好的 heads 与已有人工或半自动分析得到的已知电路有重合，这说明策略学到的不是纯噪声启发式。全文给出的关键设置包括：模型是 GPT-2 small，动作空间 144，episode 长度 50，8 个并行环境，训练总步数 2×10^5；best-of-K 评估报告 K∈{1,5}。从方法设计看，最重要的实验应包括四类：一是训练曲线，比较单环境 PPO 崩塌与多环境 PPO 稳定训练；二是 reward 设计消融，验证若去掉 control cross-entropy 项，策略会偏向通用脆弱头而不是任务电路；三是与 oracle、随机、可能还有简单贪心基线的比较；四是 held-out docstring 迁移。提供的全文片段没有完整结果表和具体百分比，因此不应虚构数值。但可以明确的是，作者把“泛化到未见任务”作为主要卖点，而不是只在单任务上复现已知头部。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读方法和实验，不必深究 RL 细节。先看 Introduction，明确它要替代的是 ACDC、EAP 这类单任务电路发现流程。然后直接看 Method 里的 reward 定义，这是整篇最有信息量的地方；如果 reward 不成立，后面的 PPO 只是实现细节。接着看 observation 设计和 best-of-K 包装，理解作者为什么把问题做成 sequential search，而不是一次性给 144 个头打分。实验部分优先看三类图表：reward 消融、训练任务与 held-out 任务上的 oracle gap、以及被选 heads 与已知 induction/IOI 电路的重合情况。若只想判断是否值得继续跟，可以用 20-30 分钟读完方法和主要结果。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 contrastive reward 是否真的隔离了 task-specific computation，还是只是偏好“对控制集伤害较小”的头；二是动作空间目前只覆盖 attention heads，若扩展到 MLP、residual stream 或 path-level intervention，RL 是否仍然可扩展。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether circuit discovery in mechanistic interpretability can be turned from a bespoke, task-by-task analysis pipeline into a learnable reinforcement-learning problem. Concretely, the goal is to train an agent that interacts with a frozen GPT-2 small by ablating attention heads one at a time and identifying heads that are causally important for a target behavior while being relatively unimportant for general language modeling. The hard part is not ablation itself, but reward design: the agent must discover task-specific circuitry rather than simply attack globally fragile heads.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, so skim is the right level. Still, it has two useful ideas. First, it reframes circuit discovery as a sequential decision problem, suggesting that interpretability procedures may admit transferable policies rather than requiring a fresh handcrafted pipeline for every task. Second, the contrastive reward is the main contribution: damage on the target task is offset by damage on a natural-text control objective, which is an attempt to separate task-specific heads from general-purpose heads. That reward construction is relevant beyond interpretability because it is a concrete example of how to isolate a specialized causal signal from a broader capability signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The environment is built on frozen GPT-2 small with 12 layers and 12 heads per layer, giving 144 discrete actions. Each action selects one attention head and zero-ablates its output at hook_z. Episodes last up to 50 steps, and repeated selection of the same head within an episode is masked out. Training uses two tasks only, induction and IOI. At every reset, the environment samples one of these tasks and regenerates a fresh batch, so the policy cannot simply memorize a fixed ranking of heads. The reward is the key design choice. For the target task, the paper measures the drop in a task-specific logit-difference metric after ablation. For a control batch of natural English text from WikiText, it measures the increase in cross-entropy. The final reward is the difference between these two effects. Heads that are broadly useful to the model should hurt both the target task and ordinary language modeling, yielding a smaller net reward; heads that are disproportionately important for the target task should receive larger positive reward. The observation includes a one-hot task indicator, a binary mask of previously tried heads, and a vector of normalized rewards for heads already tested in the current episode. This lets the policy adapt its search online within an episode. The policy itself is a small feedforward actor-critic trained with PPO over 8 parallel environments for 2e5 environment steps. At inference time, the authors also add a best-of-K wrapper: the policy samples K candidate actions, the environment scores them in parallel, and the highest-reward action is executed. Generalization is tested on a held-out docstring-completion task never seen during training.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical claim is that a single PPO policy trained on induction and IOI can approach per-episode oracle performance on those tasks and also transfer to an unseen docstring-completion task. The abstract further states that the heads preferred by the learned policy overlap with known circuits identified by prior manual or semi-automated analyses, which is important because it suggests the policy is not merely exploiting noise. The key experimental setup is explicit: GPT-2 small, 144 actions, episode length 50, 8 parallel environments, 2×10^5 total environment steps, and evaluation with K in {1,5}. The most informative experiments are likely the reward ablations, comparisons against oracle and random baselines, training stability with vectorized PPO versus the collapsed single-environment variant, and transfer to the held-out docstring task. The provided text fragment does not include the full result tables, so exact gains should not be fabricated. The important point is that the paper is trying to demonstrate policy-level generalization in circuit discovery, not just recovery of known heads on one benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is best read as a methods paper with a focused empirical demonstration. Start with the introduction to place it relative to ACDC and EAP, then go straight to the reward definition in the method section. If the contrastive reward is not convincing, the PPO machinery is secondary. After that, read the observation design and the best-of-K decision wrapper to understand why the authors formulate the problem as sequential search rather than one-shot head scoring. In the experiments, prioritize reward ablations, the gap to oracle on train and held-out tasks, and the overlap between selected heads and known induction/IOI circuits. A 20-30 minute pass is enough to decide whether the idea is worth following. The main questions worth probing are whether the control-text subtraction truly isolates task-specific computation, and whether the approach would remain tractable if extended beyond attention heads to MLPs, residual stream components, or path-level interventions.

recommendation.zh: 可看方法和 reward 设计；结论还停在 GPT-2 small 头级搜索，但自动化 circuit discovery 的 setup 比单篇案例分析更可复用。
recommendation.en: Read the method and reward design; the evidence is still GPT-2-small head search, but the automated circuit-discovery setup is more reusable than another hand-built case study.

paper.title: Manifold-Guided Attention Steering
paper.abstract: Large language models frequently produce errors in reasoning tasks despite possessing the underlying knowledge required for correct reasoning. One possible approach to improve reasoning consistency is through activation steering. However, existing activation steering approaches apply fixed, pre-computed correction vectors, ignoring where the model currently sits along its generation trajectory; the result is indiscriminate perturbation that disrupts already-correct steps as freely as erroneous o

summary.core_problem: 改进 activation steering 在推理任务中的稳定性，避免固定校正向量无差别扰动正确和错误生成步骤。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制观察加推理时干预。它把 reasoning error 关联到特定 attention head 输出激活偏离低维 correctness manifold，并尝试用轨迹感知的方式做 steering。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Manifold-Guided Attention Steering。方法从正确与错误推理轨迹的对比样本中，为选定 attention heads 学习低维子空间；生成时检测当前激活相对 correctness manifold 的偏离，并沿相关方向进行校正，而不是全程施加固定向量。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、任务集合、baseline 或定量提升。可确认的实验主张是：错误点处 attention head 输出会偏离低维正确性流形，且偏离会在后续生成步骤中累积。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of California, San Diego；Rose Yu 长期从事机器学习、时空建模和深度学习系统相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to make activation steering more reliable for reasoning by avoiding fixed correction vectors that perturb both correct and incorrect generation steps.
summary_en.importance: The contribution combines a mechanistic observation with an inference-time intervention. It links reasoning errors to attention-head activations deviating from a low-dimensional correctness manifold.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose Manifold-Guided Attention Steering. They learn low-dimensional subspaces for selected attention heads from contrastive correct and incorrect traces, then apply trajectory-aware corrections when the current activation deviates from the learned correctness manifold.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, task suites, baselines, or quantitative gains. The stated empirical claim is that attention-head outputs diverge from a low-dimensional correctness manifold at error points and that the deviation compounds over later steps.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the University of California, San Diego; Rose Yu is known for work in machine learning, spatiotemporal modeling, and deep learning systems.

recommendation.zh: 作为 steering 机制备查即可；若正文有 head-level 轨迹图，优先看那里，别被整体准确率带偏。
recommendation.en: Use it as a steering-mechanism reference; prioritize head-level trajectory plots if present, not aggregate accuracy.

paper.title: Head-Aware Key-Value Compression for Efficient Autoregressive Image Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive (AR) visual generation has achieved remarkable performance but suffers from high memory usage and low throughput, as it requires caching previously generated visual tokens. Recent research has shown that retaining only a few lines of cache tokens can maintain high-quality images while significantly reducing memory usage and improving throughput. However, these methods allocate a fixed budget to each attention head, overlooking the heterogeneity among attention heads, leading to su

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理 AR 图像生成里的 KV cache 开销问题。高分辨率图像会被展开成很长的视觉 token 序列，生成 1024×1024 图像时 KV cache 可超过 50GB。已有 LineAR 类方法发现视觉 token 主要关注相邻空间区域，因此保留少量行缓存即可。但它给每个 attention head 分配相同预算，忽略了不同 head 的注意力模式差异。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献不在训练目标，而在 AR 视觉生成的推理侧可扩展性。它的启发点是：视觉 AR 模型的 head 功能分化比文本解码更受空间结构约束，KV 压缩不应只按 token 维度做统一裁剪，而应按 head 的局部性和全局性分配预算。这对统一多模态 AR 模型、视觉 tokenizer 后的长序列生成、以及高分辨率 native multimodal LM 的部署都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 HeadKV，是一个 training-free 的 head-aware KV cache 压缩流程。论文先分析 Lumina-mGPT-786 中不同层、不同 head 的 attention map，区分两类 head：local heads 主要看空间邻域，适合用小预算滑动窗口；global heads 负责长程依赖，例如物体结构和背景，需要保留更大的历史 token 集合。关键观察是：同一个输入内，一个 head 在不同生成位置上的注意力模式较稳定；但同一个 head 在不同输入之间可能变化。因此它不依赖离线统计或固定规则，而是在生成早期用基于注意力累积的阈值准则在线判定 head 类型。判定后，local heads 使用紧凑预算和 sliding-window 更新；global heads 使用更大预算，并配合 Stratified Token Eviction，在长历史中分层保留更有信息量的 token。与 LineAR 的主要区别是预算从 uniform per-head allocation 改为 input-adaptive per-head allocation。
summary.experiments: 论文在现有 AR 图像生成模型上验证 HeadKV，重点比较 KV cache 显存、推理吞吐和生成质量。引言明确给出的背景数字是：1024×1024 生成可带来超过 50GB 的 KV cache 压力。实验结论是 HeadKV 在保持图像质量的同时降低 KV cache 使用并提升吞吐。消融的核心应围绕三点看：head 类型在线判定是否稳定，local/global 非对称预算是否优于统一预算，STE 是否能比只保留空间邻域更好地恢复长程依赖。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中关于 local/global heads 的 attention map 分析，尤其是同一输入内 head 行为跨 token position 稳定、跨输入可变这一观察。方法部分重点看 head 分类阈值、预算分配和 Stratified Token Eviction 的实现细节。实验部分建议只看质量-显存-吞吐 trade-off 表，以及 local/global budget、STE、early-stage classification 的消融。对预训练研究员来说，最值得记下的是 head heterogeneity 在视觉 AR 序列中的表现，而不是具体工程参数。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the KV-cache bottleneck in autoregressive image generation. High-resolution images are represented as long visual-token sequences, and generating a 1024×1024 image can require more than 50GB of KV cache. Prior methods such as LineAR exploit spatial locality and keep only a few recent image lines, but they assign the same cache budget to every attention head, which is inefficient when heads play different roles.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to foundation-model research is inference scalability for visual AR models rather than pretraining itself. The useful lesson is that head specialization in visual AR decoding is strongly tied to image geometry. KV compression should not be a uniform token-level pruning rule; it should allocate memory according to whether a head behaves locally or globally. This matters for unified multimodal AR systems, high-resolution visual-token generation, and native multimodal LMs where image tokens create very long decoding sequences.
summary_en.technical_approach: HeadKV is a training-free, head-aware KV-cache compression pipeline. The paper analyzes attention maps in Lumina-mGPT-786 and separates heads into local heads and global heads. Local heads mostly attend to spatial neighborhoods and can use a small sliding-window cache. Global heads capture long-range dependencies such as object structure and background context, so they need a larger budget and a more selective retention policy. A key observation is that, for a fixed input, the attention pattern of a head is largely consistent across token positions, even though the same head may behave differently across inputs. HeadKV therefore classifies head types online during an early generation stage using a thresholded attention-accumulation criterion. It then applies compact sliding-window caching to local heads and a larger-budget Stratified Token Eviction strategy to global heads. The difference from uniform methods such as LineAR is input-adaptive, per-head budget allocation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments evaluate existing AR image-generation models along three axes: KV-cache memory, decoding throughput, and image quality. The introduction gives the deployment motivation: 1024×1024 generation can exceed 50GB of KV cache. The reported conclusion is that HeadKV reduces cache memory and improves throughput while preserving visual quality. The most informative ablations are expected to be the stability of online head classification, asymmetric local/global cache budgets versus uniform budgets, and the contribution of Stratified Token Eviction for retaining long-range visual dependencies.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Start with the attention-map analysis in the introduction, especially the claim that head behavior is stable across token positions within one input but can vary across inputs. Then read the method details for the head-type criterion, cache-budget assignment, and Stratified Token Eviction. In the experiments, focus on the quality-memory-throughput trade-off table and the ablations for head classification, budget asymmetry, and STE. The main takeaway for pretraining researchers is the structure of head heterogeneity in visual AR sequences, not the exact cache hyperparameters.

recommendation.zh: 将 LLM 中常见的 Head-aware KV Cache 压缩思路迁移到了自回归图像生成（AR Vision）中，验证了视觉 token 同样存在局部/全局注意力头的异质性，做 AR Vision 效率优化的可看。
recommendation.en: Transfers the head-aware KV Cache compression idea from LLMs to autoregressive image generation, verifying the heterogeneity of local/global attention heads for visual tokens. Worth reading for AR Vision efficiency optimization.

paper.title: Mechanisms of Object Localization in Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Visually-grounded language models (VLMs) are highly effective in linking visual and textual information, yet they often struggle with basic classification and localization tasks. While classification mechanisms have been studied more extensively, the processes that support object localization remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate two representative families, LLaVA-1.5 and InternVL-3.5, using a suite of mechanistic interpretability tools, including token ablations, attention knoc

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“VLM 能不能做定位”，而是“VLM 在内部究竟靠什么机制完成定位”。更具体地说，作者想拆开两个常被混在一起的问题：一是对象类别是如何被识别出来的，二是边界框是如何从视觉 token 中被组织出来的。全文的重点在于用机制解释工具，分析 LLaVA-1.5 与 InternVL-3.5 这两类 ViT→adapter→LLM 架构中，定位信号存放在哪里、如何被 LLM 读取、分类与定位之间是并行还是串行关系，以及多视角输入时全局图与局部高分辨率图各自承担什么角色。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于提出了新的预训练方法，而在于把一个常见但模糊的现象讲清楚：当前主流 VLM 的定位能力并不是建立在精细像素级几何理解上，而更像是从 patch token 中提取“容器式”空间边界，再由少量关键注意力头把分类结果传递给定位过程。这个结论对预训练有两层启发。第一，若视觉 backbone 主要来自 CLIP 这类全局对比学习模型，那么后续 VLM 的空间 grounding 可能天然受限，instruction tuning 只能部分补救。第二，若定位依赖极少数稀疏头和较弱的位置残差信号，那么改进视觉 tokenizer、adapter 的位置编码保真度、以及训练时显式加入空间监督，可能比单纯扩大语言模型更有效。它更像一篇机制分析论文，而不是方法论文，但对理解“为什么现有 VLM 定位不稳”是有帮助的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者做了几件互相补强的事情。第一，选了两种代表性架构：LLaVA-1.5 作为单视图、无压缩、token 与 patch 一一对应的可解释基线；InternVL-3.5 作为带 pixel shuffle 压缩和 global/local 多视图输入的更复杂系统。这样可以比较“简单映射”与“压缩+多视图”下定位机制是否一致。第二，数据集不是直接拿 COCO 原始标注，而是先做标注修正和质量过滤，最后保留 3560 张图、6403 个对象标注，并额外构造控制集来压制背景上下文导致的幻觉检测。这一步很关键，因为机制分析对噪声很敏感。

具体分析工具包括：
1. token ablation：遮掉或替换部分视觉 token，观察预测框和类别变化，用来判断哪些 token 真正承载定位信息。
2. controlled perturbation：在保持对象边界不变的前提下打乱对象内部语义排列，或改变边界外区域，测试模型到底依赖“内部语义布局”还是“边界容器”。作者据此提出 containerization：只要对象对应 token 的空间范围还在，内部语义排列对框预测影响很小。
3. positional decoding：从 adapter 后或 LLM 内部表征中解码二维位置，分析模型如何从一维 token 序列恢复近似二维网格。结论是即便显式二维结构被弱化，残留的位置模式和角点锚点仍足以让 LLM 重建粗略行列结构。
4. attention knockout：逐头屏蔽注意力头，测量分类与定位性能下降，找出任务关键头。作者发现真正起因果作用的头非常少，而且 LLaVA 主要集中在早中层，InternVL 主要在中后层。
5. causal mediation analysis：进一步区分哪些头直接影响定位，哪些头先影响分类再间接影响定位。结果显示分类关键头与定位关键头只有部分重叠，但定位在因果上依赖分类相关头，支持“先识别对象，再做空间 grounding”的串行机制。

InternVL 的多视图分析也有具体结论：global thumbnail 提供主要空间信号，local high-res tiles 更多用于补充细粒度语义和小目标分类。两者不是冗余关系，而是空间与语义分工不同。这一点对多模态预训练设计是有信息量的，因为它说明更高分辨率输入未必直接改善定位，前提是全局空间框架先建立起来。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最值得看的不是单一指标，而是几组干预实验给出的稳定现象。数据上，作者在修正和过滤后的 COCO 验证集上做分析，规模为 3560 张图、6403 个对象实例。模型包括 LLaVA-1.5 7B、13B，以及 InternVL-3.5 8B。

关键结果可以概括为几条：
1. 定位信息确实已经编码在视觉 token 中，而不是主要靠语言侧“猜”出来。对对象相关 token 做消融会显著破坏框预测；对无关区域 token 的影响小得多。
2. 对象内部语义排列被打乱后，只要对象覆盖的 token 边界还在，预测框相对稳定。这支持“containerization”而不是“精细部件几何推理”。
3. 在 InternVL 中，去掉 global view 会比去掉 local views 更明显地伤害定位；相反，小目标识别和细粒度分类更依赖 local high-res crops。这说明全局图承担坐标系和粗空间布局，局部图承担语义补充。
4. 位置恢复实验表明，LLM 可以从线性化后的视觉 token 中恢复近似二维网格结构，尤其依赖角点和行边界等弱锚点，而不是完整显式二维编码。
5. 注意力头分析显示，只有极少数头对分类和定位有显著因果贡献。LLaVA 的关键头偏早中层，InternVL 偏中后层；两任务关键头大体分离，但定位会经过分类关键头。这一点比“哪些头重要”更重要，因为它说明任务分解在网络内部是有阶段性的。

摘要里没有给出完整数字表，全文的价值主要在机制证据链，而不是追求某个 benchmark 提升幅度。阅读时应重点看干预前后性能变化的相对趋势、不同层头的重要性分布、以及 global/local ablation 的对比。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不建议逐页细抠所有附录。优先看四部分。

第一，看引言和方法里对两类架构的拆解，先建立 token 流动图。LLaVA 与 InternVL 的差别决定了后面很多结论为什么会不同。

第二，看 token ablation 和 controlled perturbation 对应的主图。这部分是全文最核心的证据，决定“containerization”这个结论是否站得住。阅读时要特别注意作者如何控制对象边界、内部语义排列和背景上下文三个变量。

第三，看 InternVL 的 global/local 分析。若关心多视图 VLM 预训练，这部分比单纯的定位机制更有启发，因为它回答了高分辨率 tile 到底在帮什么。

第四，看 attention knockout 与 causal mediation。这里不要只记“少数头很重要”，更要看分类头与定位头的层分布、重叠程度，以及作者如何论证定位依赖分类。

预计 30 到 45 分钟可以抓住主线。若只想拿到对预训练有用的结论，看主文图表和实验设置即可；若想复现实验或评估结论稳健性，再看附录中的数据清洗和控制集构造。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a mechanistic question rather than a capability question: how do VLMs internally localize objects? More precisely, it separates object identification from box formation and studies where localization signals live, how the LLM recovers spatial structure from visual tokens, whether classification and localization are parallel or sequential, and how these mechanisms differ between a simple single-view model (LLaVA-1.5) and a more complex multi-view model (InternVL-3.5).
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model research is diagnostic rather than methodological. The main takeaway is that current VLM localization does not look like precise geometric reasoning over pixels. Instead, it behaves more like a token-level boundary grouping process, with a small set of attention heads carrying task-critical causal effects and with localization depending on prior object identification. For pretraining, this matters in two ways. First, if the visual backbone is inherited from CLIP-style global contrastive training, spatial grounding may remain structurally weak even after multimodal instruction tuning. Second, if localization relies on sparse heads and weak residual positional cues, then improving visual tokenization, positional fidelity through the adapter, or adding explicit spatial supervision may be more effective than simply scaling the language backbone.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The study combines architecture-aware probing with several mechanistic interventions. The authors analyze two representative VLM families. LLaVA-1.5 serves as a clean baseline because CLIP ViT-L/14 patch tokens are mapped one-to-one into the LLM space through a small MLP. InternVL-3.5 adds two complications: token compression via pixel shuffle and dynamic multi-view processing with a global thumbnail plus local high-resolution tiles. This contrast lets the paper test whether the same localization mechanism survives under compression and multi-view fusion.

The dataset is a curated subset of COCO val, not raw COCO. The authors first correct annotation issues using prior semi-automatic procedures, then filter out tiny or dominant objects, low-resolution images, and ambiguous cases. The final set contains 3,560 images and 6,403 object annotations. They also build auxiliary controls to reduce context-only hallucinated detections. This matters because mechanistic claims are fragile under noisy labels.

The main tools are:
1. Token ablations to identify which visual tokens causally support class prediction and box prediction.
2. Controlled perturbations that preserve object extent while scrambling internal semantic arrangement, or alter context outside the object, to test whether localization depends on internal semantic layout or mainly on token support boundaries.
3. Positional decoding from intermediate representations to see how a 1D token sequence still carries enough signal for the LLM to reconstruct an approximate 2D grid.
4. Attention knockout to rank heads by causal importance for classification and localization.
5. Causal mediation analysis to separate heads that directly affect localization from heads whose effect is mediated through classification.

The central claim is a containerization mechanism: object-aligned tokens define a spatial container, and the semantic arrangement inside that container matters surprisingly little for the predicted box. In InternVL, the global view carries most of the spatial signal, while local crops mainly refine semantics and help small-object classification. The paper also argues for a sequential dependency: localization-critical processing depends on classification-critical heads, even though the dominant heads for the two tasks are largely distinct.
summary_en.experiments:
The most useful results are intervention-based rather than benchmark-based. The analysis covers LLaVA-1.5 7B and 13B, and InternVL-3.5 8B, on the curated COCO-derived set with 3,560 images and 6,403 object instances.

The main empirical findings are:
1. Localization information is genuinely encoded in visual tokens. Ablating object-aligned tokens strongly disrupts box prediction, while ablating irrelevant regions has much smaller effect.
2. Scrambling semantics inside an object while preserving its token support leaves localization relatively stable. This is the key evidence for the containerization claim.
3. In InternVL, removing the global thumbnail hurts localization more than removing local high-resolution tiles, whereas local tiles contribute more to fine-grained recognition and small-object classification. This suggests a division of labor: global view for spatial frame, local view for semantic refinement.
4. Positional decoding shows that the LLM can recover an approximate 2D layout from the linearized token stream using residual positional structure and strong corner anchors, even without an explicit preserved 2D grid.
5. Only a very small number of attention heads carry strong causal effects. In LLaVA, these heads appear mostly in early-to-mid layers; in InternVL, more in mid-to-late layers. Classification and localization heads are not the same, but localization causally depends on classification-relevant heads, supporting a staged pipeline of identify first, ground later.

The paper is not about pushing a task metric by a large margin, so the important evidence is the consistency of these trends across interventions, layers, and architectures.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it as a mechanistic case study, not as a new VLM method. Four parts deserve attention.

First, inspect the architecture setup carefully. The contrast between LLaVA and InternVL explains why head locations and view roles differ later.

Second, focus on the token ablation and controlled perturbation figures. These are the core evidence for the containerization hypothesis. Pay attention to how the paper isolates object extent, internal semantic arrangement, and background context.

Third, read the global-versus-local analysis in InternVL if you care about multimodal pretraining design. It gives a concrete answer to what high-resolution tiles are actually buying.
