Fourth, study the attention knockout and mediation analysis. The important point is not merely that a few heads matter, but how classification-critical and localization-critical heads are distributed across layers and how the causal dependency is established.

About 30 to 45 minutes is enough for a solid skim. If the goal is pretraining insight, the main text figures and experimental setup are sufficient. The appendix matters mainly for data curation details and robustness checks.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §实验和 head knockout；containerization 若稳，会改变对 VLM grounding 是否语义驱动的判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the experiments and head-knockout results; if containerization holds, it changes the prior that VLM grounding is mainly semantic.

paper.title: Pyramid Forcing: Head-Aware Pyramid KV Cache Policy for High-Quality Long Video Generation
paper.abstract: Autoregressive video generation enables streaming and open-ended long video synthesis, but still suffers from long-term degradation caused by accumulated errors. Existing KVCache strategies usually apply unified historical-frame retention, implicitly assuming homogeneous historical dependencies across attention heads. We revisit historical-frame attention and reveal three distinct head types: Anchor Heads require broad long-range context, Wave Heads exhibit periodic temporal dependencies, and Ve

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是自回归视频生成中的长程退化问题：生成时间变长后，外观漂移、运动变弱、身份模糊会逐步积累。作者指出，问题不只是历史信息太多或太少，而是现有 KV cache 策略把所有 attention head 当成同一种历史依赖模式处理，导致该保留的长程锚点、周期性运动信息和局部连续性被混在一起压缩。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 基座预训练的直接相关性不强，因为工作对象是自回归视频扩散生成，不是语言模型预训练。但它对长上下文建模和推理期记忆压缩有启发：不同 attention head 对历史 token 的使用方式可能高度异质，统一的滑窗、sink token 或重要性采样策略会损失结构化依赖。对研究长上下文 LM、KV cache 压缩、流式生成和多模态 AR 生成的人，可以把它看作一个 head-aware cache policy 的案例。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Pyramid Forcing，核心是先识别 head 类型，再给不同 head 分配不同的历史帧缓存策略。作者把历史依赖模式分成三类：Anchor Heads 需要宽范围长程上下文，用来稳定外观和身份；Wave Heads 对历史帧呈周期性注意力波动，更像是在跟踪运动节律；Veil Heads 对近期历史注意力较弱，但对初始帧敏感，过多历史反而会遮蔽它们对第一帧的关注。分类阶段采用小规模 calibration set，结合 sign-rate statistics 和频域周期性来做 offline head classification。策略阶段，Anchor Heads 使用 strided retention 覆盖长历史，Wave Heads 使用 period-aligned sampling 保留周期相关帧，Veil Heads 使用 compact local merging 控制历史干扰并保留局部连续性。由于不同 head 的 cache 长度不同，作者还实现了 ragged-cache attention，以支持 head-level heterogeneous KV cache，而不是把所有 head padding 到同一长度。
summary.experiments: 实验在 Self Forcing 和 Causal Forcing 两个自回归视频生成 backbone 上评估，使用 VBench-Long，覆盖 30 秒和 60 秒长视频生成。关键数字是：在 Self Forcing 的 60 秒生成上，总分从 77.87 提升到 81.21。动态程度指标提升更明显，在 Causal Forcing 上最高提升 29.36 分，说明该策略主要缓解了长视频中运动衰减的问题。作者还强调方法同时改善 motion dynamics、visual fidelity 和 semantic consistency，但全文片段中没有给出完整消融表；最值得确认的是三类 head 分类是否稳定、每类 cache policy 的独立贡献，以及 ragged-cache attention 的额外开销。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20 到 30 分钟。建议重点看 Introduction 中对三类 head 的观察，以及方法部分的 Offline Tri-Pattern Head Classification、Pyramid KVCache Policies 和 Heterogeneous KVCache Computation Optimization。图 1 和图 2 是理解问题设定的入口：前者展示长程退化，后者对比统一 cache 与 head-aware cache。实验部分重点看 30 秒、60 秒 VBench-Long 结果和动态程度指标。若关注 LLM 长上下文，可跳过视频生成细节，重点抽取两个问题：head specialization 如何测量，以及异构 cache 如何在工程上避免 padding 浪费。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets long-horizon degradation in autoregressive video generation. As generation proceeds, appearance drifts, motion weakens, and object identity becomes less stable. The main claim is that existing KV-cache policies treat all attention heads as if they had the same temporal dependency pattern, while heads actually use historical frames in different ways.
summary_en.importance: The work is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is useful for long-context modeling and inference-time memory compression. It gives a concrete example where keeping or dropping history uniformly across heads is too coarse. For long-context language models, streaming multimodal models, and autoregressive world models, the useful lesson is that cache compression may need to respect head-level specialization rather than only token-level recency or global importance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pyramid Forcing first classifies attention heads offline and then assigns head-specific cache policies. The paper identifies three patterns. Anchor Heads attend broadly to long-range history and help preserve global anchors such as identity and appearance. Wave Heads show periodic temporal preferences and are suited to motion-related dependencies. Veil Heads are sensitive to initial frames but can be distracted by excessive historical context. The classification uses a small calibration set, sign-rate statistics, and frequency-domain periodicity. The cache policies are then matched to these behaviors: strided retention for Anchor Heads, period-aligned sampling for Wave Heads, and compact local merging for Veil Heads. Because different heads keep different numbers of cached frames, the paper introduces ragged-cache attention to support heterogeneous cache lengths without forcing a single padded layout.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses Self Forcing and Causal Forcing backbones on VBench-Long for 30-second and 60-second video generation. On Self Forcing at 60 seconds, the total score improves from 77.87 to 81.21. The largest reported gain is on dynamic degree, with an improvement of up to 29.36 points on Causal Forcing. These results suggest that the method mainly helps with motion persistence and long-term consistency. The most important missing checks to look for in the full experimental section are the stability of the head taxonomy, per-policy ablations, and the overhead of ragged-cache attention.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim reading should take about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the analysis of Anchor, Wave, and Veil Heads, then read the sections on offline head classification, head-specific cache policies, and heterogeneous cache computation. Figures 1 and 2 are the quickest way to understand the motivation. For readers working on LLM long context, the video-generation details are less important than two transferable questions: how to measure head-level temporal behavior, and how to implement variable cache lengths efficiently.

recommendation.zh: 读 head 分类和 ragged-cache 实现；它把“所有头同一缓存窗口”这个默认设定拆开了，值得对长上下文 LLM 做同类探针。
recommendation.en: Read the head taxonomy and ragged-cache implementation; it breaks the default uniform-cache-window assumption and is worth probing in long-context LLMs.

paper.title: How Language Models Process Negation
paper.abstract: We study how Large Language Models (LLMs) process negation mechanistically. First, we establish that even though open-weight models often provide wrong answers to questions involving negation, they do possess internal components that process negation correctly. Their poor accuracy is due to late-layer attention behavior that promotes simple shortcuts; ablating those attention modules greatly improves accuracy on negation-related questions. Second, we uncover how models process negation. We consi

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 LLM 如何在内部处理否定。核心问题不是模型是否会答错否定题，而是：模型内部是否已经形成了可用的否定表征，错误答案又是被哪些后续机制推出来的。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“能力缺失”和“能力被其他机制覆盖”分开了。模型在中间层已经能组合出类似“not gas → solid/liquid”的负概念表征，但后层注意力会沿用共现和表面模式，把正向概念重新推高。这说明预训练中学到的 shortcut 不只是评测误差，也会在推理路径上与正确的组合机制竞争。对研究训练数据、目标函数和训练动态的人来说，这类分析能帮助定位：错误来自表示没有学到，还是来自 late-layer 的读出和放大机制出了问题。
summary.technical_approach: 论文围绕“X that is not Y is Z”这类受控提示构造分析。作者比较两种机制假设：一种是 suppression，即模型注意到被否定的概念 Y，然后压低相关 token；另一种是 construction，即模型显式构造“not Y”的组合表征，再用这个表征促进正确答案。方法上，作者先用基于 logit difference 的 negation sensitivity 证明模型内部对否定敏感；然后定位到后层若干 attention heads 会在否定提示中促进正向答案，称为 shortcut attention heads。为干预这些头，作者提出 Attention Sinking，用来削弱特定注意力模块对输出的影响，并观察否定题准确率变化。机制追踪部分使用 path patching、LogitLens 和 Sparse AutoEncoders。结果显示，否定词的信息先被 attention 移到 Y 的位置；中层 attention 再把构造出的负概念表征移到输出位置；同一批模块也会压制 Y，但 suppression 的作用较弱。最后，MLP 的 SAE latent 会进一步放大这个负概念表征，使它影响最终预测。
summary.experiments: 数据集包含 162 个独立问题，使用 4 个模板扩展为 648 条样本，正负提示只在否定标记上不同，并为每条样本指定单 token 的正向和负向候选答案。主要机制实验集中在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 Mistral-7B-v0.1，也提到若干 open-weight 模型在否定题上常答错但仍表现出内部敏感性。关键结果有三点。第一，后层 shortcut attention modules 会在否定提示上推动正向答案；对这些模块做 Attention Sinking 后，否定题准确率显著提高。第二，在超过 80% 的数据样本中，LogitLens 能看到中层 attention 输出促进与“not Y”相关的概念，而不是只压低 Y。第三，SAE 分析显示，后续 MLP latent 会把这些负概念方向进一步放大。论文还把 shortcut attention heads 的形成追溯到预训练阶段，说明它们不是 instruction tuning 后才出现的行为。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。优先看 §4，理解 negation sensitivity、shortcut attention heads 和 Attention Sinking 的因果证据；再看 §5.1–§5.5，那里给出了“否定词搬运到 Y 位置—构造负概念表征—输出位置读出—MLP 放大”的完整路径。图 1 和展示 construction/suppression 对比的图表值得细看。附录中的数据构造也应扫一遍，因为 648 条样本的模板化设定决定了结论边界。读的时候需要留意两个限制：一是任务形式较窄，主要覆盖分类式单 token 回答；二是 Attention Sinking 能改善行为，但它更像机制验证工具，不是可直接部署的训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how LLMs compute negation internally. The main question is whether failures on negated prompts come from a missing negation mechanism, or from later components overriding a mechanism that already exists.
summary_en.importance: The useful point for pretraining research is the separation between representation acquisition and readout interference. The models appear to build compositional representations for negated concepts in mid layers, while late attention heads push answers associated with the unnegated concept through shortcut features such as co-occurrence. This matters for studying pretraining dynamics because a model can learn the right intermediate computation and still produce the wrong output if later circuits amplify easier correlations.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis uses controlled prompts of the form “X that is not Y is Z” and contrasts two hypotheses. Under suppression, the model attends to Y and suppresses tokens related to Y. Under construction, it constructs a representation for “not Y” and uses that representation to promote valid answers. The paper first measures negation sensitivity through logit differences, showing that models internally respond to negation even when their final answer is wrong. It then identifies late-layer shortcut attention heads that promote positive answers on negated prompts. The proposed Attention Sinking intervention weakens these attention modules and is used as a causal test. For the constructive pathway, the authors combine path patching, LogitLens, and Sparse AutoEncoders. The resulting account is: attention moves the negation signal to the Y position; mid-layer attention moves a constructed “not Y” representation to the output position; the same modules also suppress Y, but less strongly; MLP features then amplify the negated representation before the final prediction.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 162 unique questions rendered with 4 templates, yielding 648 examples. Positive and negated prompts differ only by a negation marker, with single-token positive and negative answer candidates. The mechanistic experiments focus on Llama-3.1-8B and Mistral-7B-v0.1, with broader observations on open-weight models. The main empirical findings are: late attention modules promote unnegated answers and ablating or sinking them improves accuracy on negated prompts; for more than 80% of examples, LogitLens evidence indicates that mid-layer attention outputs promote concepts related to “not Y”; SAE features in MLP outputs further amplify the negated representation. The paper also links shortcut heads to pretraining, suggesting that these behaviors are not only artifacts of instruction tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Read Section 4 for the behavioral-mechanistic split: negation sensitivity, shortcut attention heads, and Attention Sinking. Then read Sections 5.1–5.5 for the circuit-level account of how negation is transported, composed, and amplified. The construction-versus-suppression figures are the most informative parts. The appendix on dataset construction is worth checking because the conclusions are tied to controlled, single-token answer prompts. The main limitation is scope: the setup is clean for mechanistic analysis but does not cover broad naturalistic negation or long-form generation.

recommendation.zh: 值得看机制图和消融结果；它把“模型不懂否定”改写成“懂了但被后层捷径盖掉”。
recommendation.en: Read the mechanism diagrams and ablations; it reframes “models do not understand negation” as “they encode it, then late-layer shortcuts override it.”

paper.title: Attention Is Where You Attack
paper.abstract: Safety-aligned large language models rely on RLHF and instruction tuning to refuse harmful requests, yet the internal mechanisms implementing safety behavior remain poorly understood. We introduce the Attention Redistribution Attack (ARA), a white-box adversarial attack that identifies safety-critical attention heads and crafts nonsemantic adversarial tokens that redirect attention away from safety-relevant positions. Unlike prior jailbreak methods operating at the semantic or output-logit level

summary.core_problem: 论文想回答两个问题：安全对齐后的拒答能力在模型内部“落在”哪里（哪些注意力头/层在承担对 system prompt 的依赖），以及在不改权重的前提下，攻击者能否通过操纵注意力分配，让模型在面对有害请求时“看不见”安全指令，从而绕过拒答。
summary.importance: 对预训练/对齐研究的直接价值不在于提出新训练法，而在于给了一个更可操作的“安全机制定位”视角：安全行为不是某几个头可被简单 ablation 掉的模块，而更像一套注意力路由（routing）模式。它提示两点：1）仅靠 head ablation/归因去找“安全头”可能会误判机制；2）安全对齐可能在架构上呈现不同的“分布形态”（早层集中 vs 跨层分散），而这种形态与可攻击性相关，进而影响对齐训练时应如何让安全信号在网络中更分散、更冗余。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是白盒攻击 Attention Redistribution Attack (ARA)。核心不是最大化有害输出概率（logit-level），也不是构造语义 jailbreak，而是：
1）先定义并计算 Safety Attention Score（SAS）：衡量某个注意力头在生成过程中对 system prompt token 区间的注意力质量/占比，用它来排序“安全关键头”。
2）利用 softmax 注意力每一行在概率单纯形上的零和性质：给定 head 的注意力质量总和固定，把注意力质量从 system prompt 位置“挤走”到攻击者插入的位置，就会让安全指令在该 head 的有效信息流中消失。
3）攻击 token 不是自然语言，而是通过连续松弛优化出来的离散 token：用 Gumbel-softmax 把离散 token 选择变成可微，直接对目标 head 的 SAS 做梯度下降，优化一小段前缀（k≤10），让这些 token 在目标 head 上与 query/key 产生高亲和度，从而竞争注意力质量。
4）论文强调一个机制差异：把头置零（ablation）不等价于重分配注意力（redistribution）。前者移除一条通路，模型可能用其他通路补偿；后者是在保留通路的情况下“污染路由”，更像对计算图的定向干扰。
summary.experiments:
全文给出的关键结果集中在三类：
1）攻击有效性：在 Mistral-7B、LLaMA-3-8B 上，ARA 用约 5 个对抗 token、约 500 步梯度优化即可在不少原本拒答的有害提示上实现“拒答翻转”。文中示例数字：在验证集上，针对同样的安全重层（safety-heavy layers），Mistral-7B 翻转 72/200，LLaMA-3-8B 翻转 60/200。
2）ablation vs redistribution：将按 mean-SAS 排序的 top 安全头直接置零，基线拒答中“最多只翻转 39–50 个样本里的 1 个”（文中表述为 at most 1 flip of 39 to 50 baseline refusals），但 ARA 在相同层段上能显著翻转更多，支撑“安全不是可移除模块，而是路由模式”的论点。
3）跨架构安全头分布图谱：给出 per-head mean-SAS map。观察到 LLaMA-3-8B 的 top-20 安全头有 9 个在 layer 0；Mistral-7B 的 top-20 更偏早层聚集；Gemma-2-9B 的 top-20 分散在 14 个不同层（layer 0 到 29，单层最多 3 个）。在他们的设置下，前两者更易被 ARA 绕过，Gemma-2 更抗。论文把它作为经验观察而非定律。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（但需要带着机制问题读）：
- 先看 Introduction 里对“simplex 零和”与“redistribution 不等于 ablation”的论点，这是全文最有信息密度的机制主张。
- 重点看方法部分对 SAS 的定义与计算细节：SAS 如何选取 system token 区间、在哪些层/位置统计、是否对生成步做平均，这决定了“安全头”排序是否稳健。
- 看攻击优化细节：Gumbel-softmax 的温度/采样策略、token 预算 k、步数、以及是否对多个 prompt 做期望优化（若有），这些决定攻击是否只是过拟合单样本。
- 看 per-head mean-SAS map 的图和对应讨论：它是把“安全在网络中如何分布”具体化的部分，也最容易转化为对齐训练的假设（例如鼓励跨层冗余）。预计阅读时间 30–45 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks where refusal/safety behavior is implemented inside RLHF/instruction-tuned LLMs, and whether an attacker can bypass safety without changing weights by directly corrupting the attention routing that makes the model attend to system safety instructions.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution to pretraining/alignment research is a mechanistic framing: safety is less like a small set of removable “safety heads” and more like an attention-routing pattern. This matters because (1) head ablation can be a misleading probe for safety localization, and (2) the layer-wise distribution of safety-relevant attention (early-layer concentration vs cross-layer dispersion) appears correlated with attackability, suggesting alignment objectives may need to encourage redundancy and dispersion of safety signal paths.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Attention Redistribution Attack (ARA) is a white-box, attention-level jailbreak. Instead of optimizing harmful logits or crafting semantic prompts, it:
- Defines a Safety Attention Score (SAS) to rank attention heads by how much they attend to system-prompt tokens during generation.
- Exploits the simplex/zero-sum property of softmax attention: increasing attention mass to attacker-inserted tokens necessarily decreases mass to system tokens within a targeted head.
- Optimizes a short adversarial prefix (k ≤ 10) of non-semantic tokens. Discrete token selection is relaxed via Gumbel-softmax so gradients can directly minimize SAS on selected heads/layers.
- Emphasizes a key distinction: ablation (zeroing heads) removes a pathway and can be compensated; redistribution keeps the pathway but poisons routing, which is harder for the model to route around.
summary_en.experiments:
Key reported findings:
- Effectiveness with small budgets: ~5 adversarial tokens and ~500 gradient steps can flip a meaningful fraction of previously-refused harmful prompts on Mistral-7B and LLaMA-3-8B (e.g., 72/200 and 60/200 flips on their validation prompts, respectively).
- Ablation vs redistribution: zeroing top SAS-ranked heads yields at most 1 flip among 39–50 baseline refusals, while ARA targeting the same safety-heavy layers flips far more, supporting the “routing, not a localized module” claim.
- Cross-architecture head maps: per-head mean-SAS maps show LLaMA-3-8B has 9 of top-20 safety heads in layer 0; Mistral-7B also concentrates early; Gemma-2-9B spreads top-20 across 14 layers (0–29). In their setup, the more dispersed Gemma-2 is more resistant to ARA.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the Introduction carefully for the two central claims: simplex zero-sum attention and why redistribution differs from ablation.
- Focus on the exact SAS definition and measurement protocol; this determines whether “safety head” identification is stable.
- Check the optimization details (Gumbel-softmax settings, token budget, steps, whether prompts are optimized per-instance or across a set) to judge generality vs overfitting.
- Spend time on the per-head mean-SAS maps and discussion; this is the part most likely to translate into alignment/pretraining hypotheses (e.g., enforcing cross-layer redundancy). ~30–45 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看攻击构造和 ablation-vs-redistribution 结果；若复现干净，它会削弱“删 head 等于理解 head”的习惯。
recommendation.en: Read the attack construction and the ablation-vs-redistribution result; if it replicates, it weakens the habit of equating head deletion with head understanding.

paper.title: Shared Lexical Task Representations Explain Behavioral Variability In LLMs
paper.abstract: One of the most common complaints about large language models (LLMs) is their prompt sensitivity -- that is, the fact that their ability to perform a task or provide a correct answer to a question can depend unpredictably on the way the question is posed. We investigate this variation by comparing two very different but commonly-used styles of prompting: instruction-based prompts, which describe the task in natural language, and example-based prompts, which provide in-context few-shot demonstrat

summary.core_problem: 这项工作研究同一个任务在 instruction prompt 和 few-shot example prompt 下为什么会出现明显性能波动。核心问题不是再证明 prompt sensitivity 存在，而是定位两类提示方式是否调用了共享的内部任务表示，以及这种共享表示的激活强弱能否解释行为差异。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在机制层面。它把 prompt 形式差异和模型内部的任务表示强度联系起来，说明同一任务可能有跨提示风格共享的“词汇化任务表示”，而不是完全依赖每种 prompt 格式各自的机制。这有助于理解 ICL、instruction following 和任务执行之间的接口，也对预训练数据中 instruction、demonstration、definition 类样本的配比和混合方式有间接参考价值。贡献量级偏机制分析，不是新的训练目标或架构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是用 vocabulary projection 解码单个 attention head 的输出，寻找那些输出词汇语义上描述任务本身的 head。作者称这类表示为 lexical task representation。例如在 Antonym 任务中，相关 head 解码出的高概率词不是某个输入词的反义词，而是 “opposite”“reverse” 这类任务定义词。它与 function vector 的区别在于：function vector 更偏向由 few-shot ICL 格式诱发，并作为触发任务执行的向量；lexical task representation 更像对任务含义的显式词汇化编码，并能在 instruction prompt 和 example prompt 之间共享。随后作者把这类 lexical task heads 与负责知识或属性提取的 retrieval heads 区分开，分析前者如何调制后者，使模型从输入主体中抽取正确属性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 13 个自回归 Transformer 模型、3 个模型家族、17 个简单任务、3 个组合任务和 1 个自由形式代码生成任务。主文结果主要基于 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct。任务包括类似属性抽取、反义词、翻译等需要明确任务语义的设置。关键结果有三点：第一，lexical task heads 在 instruction-based 和 example-based prompts 中都能被识别出来，说明它们不是单一 prompt 模板的产物。第二，这些 head 的激活强度与不同 prompt 下的性能波动相关。第三，因果干预显示，lexical task heads 对任务表现有可测贡献；在 17 个任务中，它们至少解释约 10%，最高可到约 90% 的任务性能差异。作者还把 retrieval heads 作为执行侧组件，展示 lexical task representation 的强弱会影响 retrieval heads 取回正确答案的能力。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 45 分钟。重点看第 2.2 节，理解 lexical task heads 的定义、筛选标准和 vocabulary projection 方法；再看第 2.3 节，确认这些 head 为什么能被称为跨 prompt 风格共享；第 2.4.1 节最关键，那里连接了激活强度、retrieval heads 和行为波动。附录 G.1 值得扫一遍，因为 10% 到 90% 的因果贡献范围决定了结论的强弱。附录 I 可用于区分 lexical task representation 和 function vector，避免把两者混在一起。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why semantically equivalent tasks can show large performance variation under instruction-style prompts versus few-shot example prompts. The target is not prompt sensitivity as a surface phenomenon, but whether different prompt formats activate a shared internal task representation whose strength predicts the observed behavioral variability.
summary_en.importance: The value for pretraining research is mechanistic. The results suggest that instruction following and in-context learning may share a lexicalized representation of task meaning, rather than relying only on format-specific circuits. This informs how to think about the interface between definitions, demonstrations, and task execution in pretraining mixtures. It is not a new training recipe, but it gives useful evidence about what kinds of internal representations pretraining can induce.
summary_en.technical_approach: The key tool is projecting individual attention-head outputs into vocabulary space and inspecting whether the decoded tokens describe the task itself. Heads are classified as producing lexical task representations when their decoded vocabulary matches the task definition rather than the answer. For an antonym task, for example, such heads decode words like “opposite” or “reverse,” not a specific antonym for the query word. This differs from function vectors, which are usually extracted from in-context demonstrations and act more like task-triggering vectors. The paper also separates these lexical task heads from retrieval heads, which retrieve subject-specific attributes or answers. The proposed mechanism is that lexical task heads encode what task should be done, and their activation strength modulates retrieval heads that execute the task.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments span 13 autoregressive Transformer language models from three model families, 17 simple tasks, three compositional tasks, and one free-form code generation task. The main results are reported on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The central findings are: lexical task heads appear under both instruction-based and example-based prompts; their activation strength correlates with prompt-level performance variation; and causal interventions on these heads explain a nontrivial portion of task performance, ranging from at least about 10% to as much as about 90% across the 17 tasks. The retrieval-head analysis supports a two-part picture: task meaning is encoded by lexical task heads, while answer extraction is handled by retrieval heads whose effectiveness depends on the strength of the task representation.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Read Section 2.2 for the definition and identification procedure for lexical task heads. Section 2.3 is important for the claim that the mechanism is shared across prompt styles. Section 2.4.1 is the main causal story linking activation strength, retrieval heads, and behavioral variability. Appendix G.1 is worth checking for the intervention effect sizes, and Appendix I is useful for separating lexical task representations from function vectors.

recommendation.zh: 读 lexical task heads 的定位实验；它把 prompt sensitivity 从玄学拉回可测机制。
recommendation.en: Read the lexical-task-head localization experiments; they turn prompt sensitivity into a measurable mechanism rather than prompt folklore.

paper.title: Preference Heads in Large Language Models: A Mechanistic Framework for Interpretable Personalization
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong implicit personalization ability, yet most existing approaches treat this behavior as a black box, relying on prompt engineering or fine tuning on user data. In this work, we adopt a mechanistic interpretability perspective and hypothesize the existence of a sparse set of Preference Heads, attention heads that encode user specific stylistic and topical preferences and exert a causal influence on generation. We introduce Differential Preference Steering

summary.core_problem: 解释并利用 LLM 的“隐式个性化”能力：模型如何在不微调的情况下根据用户历史/画像呈现不同风格与偏好？作者提出一个可检验的机制假设：个性化主要由少量稀疏的注意力头（Preference Heads）承载，并且这些头对生成有可观测的因果影响。
summary.importance:
对基座预训练的直接影响有限（更偏机制分析 + 解码期干预），但对两类研究有启发：
1) 机制层面：把“个性化/风格”从黑盒行为拆成可定位的电路组件，提供了可复用的因果发现范式（head-level causal masking + 贡献度量）。
2) post-train 接口：给出一种 training-free 的个性化路径，可能减少为每个用户做 LoRA/微调的需求；同时也提示在对齐/偏好建模时，模型内部可能存在可分离的偏好通路，值得在训练中显式正则或约束。

从筛选角度，它不是预训练方法论文，但属于“机制分析/可控生成”里相对有结构的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
两步：发现 + 利用。

(1) Preference Heads 发现：
- 用因果 masking 分析对每个 attention head 做干预（屏蔽/移除该 head 的输出），观察对“用户对齐生成”的影响。
- 定义 Preference Contribution Score (PCS)：度量某个 head 对偏好对齐程度的因果贡献（论文表述为直接测量 head 对 user-aligned generation 的 causal impact）。核心是把‘相关性’变成‘可干预的贡献’，避免仅凭激活强度或注意力模式做归因。

(2) Differential Preference Steering (DPS) 解码期个性化：
- 在解码时对比“启用 Preference Heads”与“抑制 Preference Heads”两种预测分布，取差分信号并放大，用来提升偏好一致的续写、压制更通用/中性的续写。
- 进一步做 cluster-aware steering：考虑用户异质性，让相似用户共享部分偏好电路（减少每个用户单独找 head 的成本，并提升稳定性）。

与 CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe 这类对比解码的区别在于：DPS 的对比对象不是层/检索头等预定义结构，而是通过因果分析定位到的“个性化相关头”。
summary.experiments:
模型：LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct、Mistral-7B-Instruct、Qwen2-7B-Instruct。
数据与任务：LaMP 个性化基准，覆盖生成（headline、scholarly title、tweet paraphrase 等）与预测类任务（分类/回归，如 citation identification、movie tagging、product rating）。
指标：生成用 ROUGE-1/ROUGE-L/METEOR；分类用 Acc/F1；回归用 MAE/RMSE。
对比基线：CAD、DoLa、DeCoRe（均为解码期干预/对比类方法）。

从全文描述的结论层面：DPS 在多个开源指令模型与多类 LaMP 任务上提升个性化一致性/风格对齐，同时保持内容连贯与计算效率；并通过“mask 掉这些 heads 会破坏个性化行为”来支持其因果性主张。具体提升幅度需要结合论文实验表格逐项查看（摘要未给出统一的绝对数字）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（45–60 分钟）：
- 先读方法部分 PCS 的定义与 head masking 的实现细节：干预发生在什么位置（head 输出/attention weights/OV 投影之后）、如何避免与 dropout/kv-cache 等实现细节混淆、PCS 的统计是否跨样本/跨用户聚合。
- 再读 DPS 的解码公式：差分分布如何与原 logits 合成、放大系数如何选、是否引入温度/归一化以避免退化。
- 实验部分重点看：
  - 与 CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe 的对比表（不同任务类型是否一致受益）；
  - “mask preference heads 会破坏个性化”的因果验证；
  - cluster-aware 版本是否显著减少 per-user 搜索成本。
- 预计不需要逐字精读数据集介绍；把时间留给消融与可视化（head 分布、激活模式与风格维度的对应）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to make LLM personalization mechanistically interpretable and controllable: instead of treating user-specific style/topic adaptation as a black box, it hypothesizes that a sparse set of attention heads (“Preference Heads”) causally mediates personalized generation.
summary_en.importance: It is closer to mechanistic interpretability plus decoding-time control than pretraining. Still, it matters to foundation-model researchers in two ways: (1) it offers a reusable causal-discovery recipe at the head level (masking + contribution scoring) for isolating circuits behind high-level behaviors; (2) it suggests a training-free personalization path that could reduce per-user fine-tuning, and hints that preference/alignment signals may flow through partially separable internal pathways—useful when thinking about how post-training interfaces with the base model.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Two stages: identify and steer.

1) Identifying Preference Heads:
- Perform causal masking interventions on individual attention heads (ablate/mask a head) and measure the impact on user-aligned outputs.
- Define a Preference Contribution Score (PCS) to quantify each head’s causal contribution to preference-aligned generation, aiming to move from correlational attribution to intervention-based evidence.

2) Differential Preference Steering (DPS):
- At decoding time, contrast the model’s token distribution with Preference Heads enabled vs. suppressed, then amplify the differential signal to promote preference-consistent continuations and suppress generic ones.
- Extend to cluster-aware steering so users with similar profiles can share partially overlapping preference circuits, reducing per-user overhead.

Compared with CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe, DPS’s contrast set is not a fixed structural choice (layers, retrieval heads) but a causally discovered subset tied to personalization.
summary_en.experiments:
Models: LLaMA-3-8B-Instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct, Qwen2-7B-Instruct.
Benchmark: LaMP, covering both user-conditioned generation tasks and prediction tasks (classification/regression).
Metrics: ROUGE-1/ROUGE-L/METEOR for generation; Accuracy/F1 for classification; MAE/RMSE for regression.
Baselines: CAD, DoLa, DeCoRe.

Reported outcomes: DPS improves personalization fidelity/style alignment across models and tasks while maintaining coherence and efficiency; masking the identified heads disrupts personalized behavior, supporting the causal claim. Exact deltas are table-dependent and should be read directly from the main results tables (the provided excerpt does not include consolidated numbers).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes):
- Read the PCS definition and the exact masking intervention: where the ablation is applied (head output vs. attention weights), how scores are aggregated across users/examples, and how they control for confounds.
- Read the DPS decoding equation carefully: how the differential distribution is combined with base logits, how the steering strength is chosen, and what normalization/temperature is used to avoid degeneration.
- In experiments, focus on: (a) head-to-head comparisons vs. CAD/DoLa/DeCoRe across task types, (b) causal validation via masking, (c) cluster-aware steering’s cost/benefit.
- Spend less time on dataset boilerplate; prioritize ablations and interpretability visualizations (which heads, which layers, and how activations map to style/topic dimensions).

recommendation.zh: 如果你做机制分析，这篇值得看 head-level 因果识别是否真有稀疏性；若只是做 pretrain，可只读 PCS 定义和 ablation，别把“功能定位”过早当成稳定事实。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the head-level causal identification if you do mech interp; if you are mainly a pretraining person, just inspect the PCS definition and ablations, and do not over-trust functional localization too early.

paper.title: Can We Locate and Prevent Stereotypes in LLMs?
paper.abstract: Stereotypes in large language models (LLMs) can perpetuate harmful societal biases. Despite the widespread use of models, little is known about where these biases reside in the neural network. This study investigates the internal mechanisms of GPT 2 Small and Llama 3.2 to locate stereotype related activations. We explore two approaches: identifying individual contrastive neuron activations that encode stereotypes, and detecting attention heads that contribute heavily to biased outputs. Our exper

summary.core_problem: 如何在模型内部定位“刻板印象/偏见”相关的表征与计算路径，并据此做定向干预以减少偏见输出。
summary.importance: 属于机制分析+安全方向：尝试把“偏见”从输出层面的现象，落到可操作的内部单元（神经元/注意力头）上，为可解释性缓解（activation editing / head ablation）提供线索。
summary.technical_approach: 两条线：1）用对比式触发（stereotype vs. non-stereotype prompts）寻找差分激活显著的“对比神经元”；2）用注意力头贡献度分析，找对偏见输出影响最大的 heads，并尝试形成可复用的“bias fingerprint”。
summary.experiments: 对象为 GPT-2 Small 与 Llama 3.2（具体版本/规模以正文为准）；主要报告定位到的神经元/注意力头集合及其对偏见输出的贡献，目标是展示可定位性与初步缓解效果（摘要未给出定量缓解幅度与对照设置细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to localize stereotype-related representations/computation inside LLMs and use targeted interventions to reduce biased generations.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic interpretability for safety: moves bias from an output-level symptom to actionable internal units (neurons/attention heads), potentially enabling activation editing or head-level mitigation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two tracks: (1) contrastive prompting to identify neurons with large activation deltas between stereotype vs non-stereotype conditions; (2) attribution-style analysis to find attention heads that disproportionately drive biased outputs, forming a 'bias fingerprint'.
summary_en.experiments: Studies GPT-2 Small and Llama 3.2 (exact variants/sizes per paper); reports identified neuron/head sets and their contribution to biased outputs, with preliminary mitigation attempts (abstract lacks clean quantitative deltas and controls).

recommendation.zh: 更像安全可解释性的探索性作业：方法不新、setup 可能不够干净；只需扫结果可复现性与干预是否稳健。
recommendation.en: Exploratory safety interpretability with likely noisy attribution; skim for whether the neuron/head interventions are robust and reproducible, not for new methodology.

summary.core_problem: 论文想回答：LLM 在生成时回忆关系知识时，哪类中间表示最适合被线性探针忠实地读出关系类型，以及为什么有些关系更容易线性分离。
summary.importance: 这是机制分析工作，不改训练方法，但对“知识存在哪里、如何被读出”给出更细的表征比较。对做 interpretability、知识编辑或训练诊断的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 作者系统比较从注意力头贡献、MLP 贡献等不同路径提取的 latent representations，用线性探针做 relation classification；再结合特征归因分析，研究 probe 成功与关系特异性、实体连通度、信号在多头间分布程度之间的关联。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模与数据集名称，但核心实验是对不同 latent feature family 做线性分类对比。主要结论是：按头分解的 attention 对 residual stream 的贡献，比其他候选表示更适合线性关系分类；同时某些关系之所以难，是因为信号更分散、关系更泛化。没有训练规模或新 benchmark 的信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which internal representations best support faithful linear readout of relational knowledge during generation, and why some relation types are easier to linearly classify than others.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic analysis paper rather than a training-method paper. It is useful for interpretability, knowledge localization, and training diagnostics, but it does not directly change pretraining practice.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors systematically compare latent representations derived from attention-head contributions, MLP contributions, and related internal signals, using linear probes for relation classification. They then apply feature attribution to connect probe success with relation specificity, entity connectedness, and how distributed the signal is across heads.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or datasets, but the main experiment is a controlled comparison of feature families for linear relation classification. The key result is that per-head attention contributions to the residual stream are stronger features than the alternatives, and that harder relations tend to have more diffuse signals and lower specificity.

recommendation.zh: 偏解释性小论文，不改 pretrain prior；若你在做知识定位，只看 probe feature 对比和“信号分散度”那部分就够了。
recommendation.en: A modest interpretability paper that won’t change your pretraining prior; if you care about knowledge localization, just read the probe-feature comparison and the signal-dispersion analysis.

paper.title: Jailbreaking the Matrix: Nullspace Steering for Controlled Model Subversion

summary.core_problem: 在已有对齐/安全防护下，如何以更少查询、更高成功率实现对LLM的越狱与受控“模型颠覆”(subversion)。
summary.importance: 贡献类型为安全攻击方法与机制级干预：提出电路/注意力头层面的闭环干预攻击（而非纯提示工程），对理解对齐脆弱性、评估防护强度与设计更鲁棒的对齐策略具有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: Head-Masked Nullspace Steering (HMNS)：(i) 识别对模型默认安全行为最具因果贡献的注意力头；(ii) 通过对这些头的写入路径进行定向列(mask)抑制；(iii) 在被抑制子空间的正交补（nullspace）中注入扰动以规避直接抵消；并采用“检测-干预”闭环，在多次解码尝试中迭代重新识别因果头并重复干预。包含残差范数缩放、nullspace约束注入等关键组件。
summary.experiments: 在多个越狱基准、强安全防护与多种常用语言模型上评测；报告达到SOTA攻击成功率且查询次数更少；消融显示nullspace注入、残差缩放与迭代重识别对效果关键（摘要未给出具体模型/数据/数值细节）。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks how to jailbreak aligned LLMs with fewer queries and higher success by directly intervening in internal mechanisms rather than relying purely on prompt engineering.
summary_en.importance: The paper contributes an attack methodology that operates at the attention-head/circuit level, offering mechanistic insight into alignment fragility and providing a stronger basis for evaluating and hardening safety defenses.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces Head-Masked Nullspace Steering (HMNS): identify attention heads causally supporting safe behavior, suppress their write pathways via masking, and inject perturbations constrained to the corresponding nullspace to avoid direct cancellation; a detect-and-intervene loop iteratively re-identifies causal heads over multiple decoding attempts, with components such as residual-norm scaling and nullspace-constrained injection.
summary_en.experiments: It is evaluated on multiple jailbreak benchmarks across several common LLMs and strong safety settings, reporting state-of-the-art attack success with fewer queries; ablations attribute gains to nullspace injection, residual scaling, and iterative re-identification, though the summary provides no specific models or numbers.

recommendation.zh: 作为攻击面备查即可：电路级闭环干预挺新，但对预训练动作指导弱；只扫方法图和成功率/查询数表。
recommendation.en: Good to know as an attack primitive: the closed-loop circuit-level steering is novel, but it doesn’t translate into clear pretraining actions; skim the method schematic and the success/query tables.
